Key features include a modular design for configuring patient attributes, antibiotic resistance dynamics modeled via a leaky-balloon abstraction, and tools to explore partial observability through noise, bias, and delay in observations. The package is compatible with the Gymnasium RL API, enabling users to train and test RL agents under diverse clinical scenarios. From an ML perspective, the package provides a configurable benchmark environment for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, including partial observability induced by noisy, biased, and delayed observations. By providing a customizable and extensible framework, abx_amr_simulator offers a valuable tool for studying AMR dynamics and optimizing antibiotic stewardship strategies under realistic uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源 Python 仿真包 abx_amr_simulator，将抗生素处方与抗微生物耐药性(AMR)动态建模为兼容 Gymnasium API 的 MDP/POMDP 环境：以患者为单位生成合成病例群体、用"漏气球"(leaky-balloon)累积-衰减模型刻画各抗生素的社区耐药水平、用可调权重的个体-社区复合奖励函数平衡即时临床获益与长期耐药管理，并可显式注入噪声、偏差与延迟以制造部分可观测性，支持 RL 智能体训练、Optuna 调参、YAML 模块化配置与 Streamlit 图形界面。区别于已有的病原体层级模拟器，该包定位为"患者决策层级"的策略学习基准环境。
AI.motivation: 抗微生物耐药性(AMR)是重大全球公共卫生威胁，2019 年估计 495 万例死亡与耐药细菌感染相关，尽管抗生素管理项目(ASP)已广泛开展，但其群体层面的定量评估证据仍有限：既有观察性研究范围窄、周期短，且关键系统组件不可观测——抗生素暴露受农业使用、环境污染等未测因素影响，社区耐药水平也缺乏公认测量方法。此外，已有仿真模型多聚焦病原体层面（微生物演化、治疗循环、多层级耐药模拟、个体化细菌种群模型），无法直接支持对"处方策略"本身的学习与评估。填补这一空白需要一个可控制可观测性（噪声、偏差、延迟）、患者异质性与耐药动力学的可控仿真框架，以支持 RL 在延迟反馈、长程信用分配场景下的策略学习与基准测试。
AI.method: 软件以 ABXAMREnv 为父环境，由三大组件构成：(1) PatientGenerator 在每个时间步生成固定数量合成患者，每人含感染概率 π_i、获益乘子 (φ_b,i, ω_b,i)、失败乘子 (φ_f,i, ω_f,i) 与自愈概率 ρ_i，可配置为同质/异质群体并对观测值注入噪声或偏差，真实感染状态为潜变量；(2) AMR_LeakyBalloon 为每种抗生素维护一个带衰减的软上界累积器，抗性压力随处方频率上升、无选择压力时随时间衰减，潜在压力经 sigmoid 映射为可观测耐药水平 σ_a（即新发感染耐药概率），由平坦度参数与泄漏参数控制，并支持交叉耐药；(3) RewardCalculator 给出标量奖励 R_overall(t) = (1−λ)·⟨R̃_individual⟩ + λ·⟨R_community⟩，λ∈[0,1] 权衡个体临床净收益与社区耐药最小化。环境符合 Gymnasium API，可封装为 POMDP 并在观测中引入噪声、偏差、延迟；episode 仅在 max_time_steps 处终止。工程层面提供 YAML 分层子配置与 umbrella 配置、CLI 训练脚本（支持子配置与单参数覆盖）、Optuna 端到端超参搜索、Streamlit 的 Experiment Runner 与 Experiment Viewer 两个 GUI，以及自定义子类扩展接口。
AI.result: 论文给出软件描述与可复现的工作流演示：安装（conda python=3.10、git clone、pip install -e .）、用 setup_config_folders_with_defaults 生成 environment/reward_calculator/patient_generator/agent_algorithm 等子配置与 umbrella base_experiment.yaml（训练/评估频率、种子、轨迹日志等），并通过 python -m abx_amr_simulator.training.train 及 --s/--p 覆盖参数运行训练，可构造三抗生素交叉耐药等场景；结果按时间戳存入 results/ 目录并由 GUI 展示累计临床结局等诊断图。文中未给出具体 RL 算法的性能基准数值，主要结论为该环境可作为可控、可扩展的基准平台，用于研究延迟耐药信息（如低频更新的 antibiogram）与有偏风险评估如何塑造最优处方行为。
AI.conclusion: abx_amr_simulator 通过模块化、可扩展、低门槛的框架，把 AMR 动力学与处方策略优化统一到 Gymnasium 兼容的 MDP/POMDP 表述中，填补了"定量评估处方干预长期效应"与"面向策略学习的患者层级基准环境"之间的空白；其核心价值在于可显式操控数据质量（噪声、偏差、延迟），为公共卫生与流行病学研究者提供了一个"定量实验室"，用于量化数据缺陷对抗菌药物管理的阻碍，并评估更频繁的耐药谱更新、更好的患者风险评估等干预的收益。作者指出既有文献多停留在摘要层面、缺乏统一术语与实践标准，因此该工作也承担了概念梳理与方法论整合的作用。后续计划扩展非平稳动力学（人口结构变化、季节性感染趋势、不可逆耐药机制）以及多智能体-多地域场景（患者迁移传播耐药、仅基于本地数据的处方决策、跨地域信息不对称与协调机制），以支持指南更新频率、策略失效信号识别与去中心化处方系统的研究。

title: Gender Bias in Generative AI-assisted Recruitment Processes
summary: In recent years, generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) systems have assumed increasingly crucial roles in selection processes, personnel recruitment and analysis of candidates' profiles. However, the employment of large language models (LLMs) risks reproducing, and in some cases amplifying, gender stereotypes and bias already present in the labour market. The objective of this paper is to evaluate and measure this phenomenon, analysing how a state-of-the-art generative model (GPT-5) suggests occupations based on gender and work experience background, focusing on under-35-year-old Italian graduates. The model has been prompted to suggest jobs to 24 simulated candidate profiles, which are balanced in terms of gender, age, experience and professional field. Although no significant differences emerged in job titles and industry, gendered linguistic patterns emerged in the adjectives attributed to female and male candidates, indicating a tendency of the model to associate women with emotional and empathetic traits, while men with strategic and analytical ones. The research raises an ethical question regarding the use of these models in sensitive processes, highlighting the need for transparency and fairness in future digital labour markets.

AI.tldr: 本文以 24 份模拟的意大利 35 岁以下毕业生履历为输入，提示 ChatGPT-5（GPT-5）扮演职业顾问，为每位候选人推荐职位、行业并给出 3 个形容词，共 72 次输出。卡方检验显示：建议的职位名称（p=0.27）与行业（p=0.38）在性别间无显著差异，但用于描述候选人的形容词存在显著性别差异（p=0.00176）：女性多被赋予情感与共情类特质（Relational & Emotional，27 女 vs 11 男），男性多被赋予领导影响力（25 男 vs 13 女）与务实可靠（37 男 vs 21 女）类特质。这表明模型在招聘辅助场景中会复制传统性别刻板印象，作者据此质疑将 GenAI 用于高风险用人决策的适宜性。
AI.motivation: 生成式人工智能（GenAI/LLM）正日益深入招聘筛选、候选人分析与岗位推荐环节，因其训练语料承载社会既有不平等，存在复现甚至放大劳动力市场性别刻板印象的风险，可能加剧职业隔离与薪酬差距；已有研究（Nakano 等、Treude 等）已证实 LLM 在候选人评价与角色分配中会依性别、国别产生偏置。然而在人力资源这一高敏感领域，缺乏对“模型会为不同性别的相似资历者推荐何种职业与描述”的系统度量。因此本文针对意大利 35 岁以下青年毕业生这一在劳动力市场数字化中最早受算法把关影响的群体，考察 GPT-5 的职业建议输出是否依赖性别而对不同社会角色产生偏置。
AI.method: 采用 Goal-Question-Metric（GQM）模板界定研究目标，围绕三个研究问题（RQ1 职位名称、RQ2 行业类别、RQ3 描述性形容词是否随性别变化）展开。实验对象为 24 个虚构求职者画像（12 女、12 男，意大利籍、35 岁以下、已毕业），在年龄、工作经验（Junior 0–5 年／Senior >5 年）与专业领域三个自变量上做平衡的全因子设计；专业领域依据 ISCO-08 的九个非军职职业大类归入 Cognitive（管理者与专业人员）、Socio-Relational（技术员与助理、文职支持、服务与销售）、Technical（农林渔、手工技艺、设备操作与装配、基础职业）三个宏观领域（由一位作者依据官方说明完成映射，其余作者共识校验）。使用标准化提示词将 ChatGPT-5 设定为“职业顾问”，要求按固定格式输出“Job Suggested / Industry / Adjectives（3 个形容词）”，每个画像重复 3 次，共 72 条观测，数据采集于 2025 年 8–9 月，使用 GPT-5 默认设置。所有唯一职位名、行业与形容词由一位作者按扎根理论开放编码法（open coding）归并为同质语义类别，再由其余作者逐一核验至共识，将类别作为因变量与性别进行卡方独立性检验。
AI.result: （1）职位名称：女性在 HR & People Operations 类过度代表（5 女 vs 1 男），男性在 Operations, Technical & Manufacturing 类偏多（6 男 vs 3 女），但 Product, Data & Research 类完全均衡（12 vs 12）；χ² 检验 p=0.27，不能拒绝原假设，未发现系统性职业隔离。（2）行业：HR 行业同样女性偏多（5 vs 1），Manufacturing & Industrial（12 vs 12）、Technology（7 vs 5）基本均衡；p=0.38，无系统性模式，仅存在轻微不对称。（3）形容词：出现显著性别差异（p=0.00176，表 II 记为 0.002，拒绝原假设）。女性多属 Relational & Emotional 类别（27 女 vs 11 男），如 approachable、empathetic、supportive；男性集中于 Leadership & Influence（25 男 vs 13 女，如 influential、persuasive、ambitious）与 Practical & Reliability（37 男 vs 21 女，如 determined、experienced、responsible）。即模型虽在“推荐何种职业”这一层未做性别区分，却在“如何描述候选人”这一语言层复制了传统的情感化女性/理性化男性刻板印象。有效性威胁包括：合成画像难以覆盖真实求职者复杂性，开放编码带有主观性，性别仅作二元操作化（因样本量小未纳入非二元性别），单一模型与单一提示策略、默认参数及模型版本更新削弱可复现性，且样本限于意大利青年毕业生限制了外部效度。
AI.conclusion: 实验结论为：在 GenAI 辅助的招聘流程中，GPT-5 的职业建议在职位名称与行业层面表现相对中性，但在描述候选人的语言层面存在统计显著的性别偏置，强化了“女性情感化/共情、男性理性、领导与务实”的社会刻板印象。作者主张，问题不在于仅制定伦理准则，而在于对 GenAI 在敏感决策中的角色进行上游批判性评估——算法工具会将个体层面的人为偏见转化为大规模算法伤害，因此在高风险领域使用此类技术本身值得质疑，并需要计算机科学、社会学与性别研究的跨学科协作以促进数字劳动力市场的公平与透明。未来工作包括：扩大样本并纳入非异性规范性别身份与其他社会经济变量、测试多个模型与提示策略；作者已启动第二阶段实验，将基于真实招聘广告研究模型对“理想候选人”的文本与视觉描述中的性别偏置。全部实验结果以开放数据形式发布（Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.18242470）。

title: Relaxed Efficient Acquisition of Context and Temporal Features
summary: In many biomedical applications, measurements are not freely available at inference time: each laboratory test, imaging modality, or assessment incurs financial cost, time burden, or patient risk. Longitudinal active feature acquisition (LAFA) seeks to optimize predictive performance under such constraints by adaptively selecting measurements over time, yet the problem remains inherently challenging due to temporally coupled decisions (missed early measurements cannot be revisited, and acquisition choices influence all downstream predictions). Moreover, real-world clinical workflows typically begin with an initial onboarding phase, during which relatively stable contextual descriptors (e.g., demographics or baseline characteristics) are collected once and subsequently condition longitudinal decision-making. Despite its practical importance, the efficient selection of onboarding context has not been studied jointly with temporally adaptive acquisition. We therefore propose REACT (Relaxed Efficient Acquisition of Context and Temporal features), an end-to-end differentiable framework that simultaneously optimizes (i) selection of onboarding contextual descriptors and (ii) adaptive feature--time acquisition plans for longitudinal measurements under cost constraints. REACT employs a Gumbel--Sigmoid relaxation with straight-through estimation to enable gradient-based optimization over discrete acquisition masks, allowing direct backpropagation from prediction loss and acquisition cost. Across real-world longitudinal health and behavioral datasets, REACT achieves improved predictive performance at lower acquisition costs compared to existing longitudinal acquisition baselines, demonstrating the benefit of modeling onboarding and temporally coupled acquisition within a unified optimization framework.

AI.tldr: REACT是一个端到端可微的框架，用于纵向主动特征采集，同时优化入职上下文描述符的选择和时间自适应的特征-时间采集计划，在成本约束下实现更好的预测性能
AI.motivation: 在许多生物医学应用中，测量在推理时并非免费获取，每次实验室检查、影像学检查或评估都会产生成本、时间负担或患者风险。纵向主动特征采集（LAFA）旨在在成本约束下优化预测性能，但由於时间耦合决策（早期错过的测量无法回溯，采集选择影响所有下游预测），该问题本质上具有挑战性。此外，实际临床工作流程通常从入职阶段开始，在此期间收集相对稳定的上下文描述符（如人口统计学或基线特征），然后再进行纵向决策。入职上下文的高效选择尚未与时间自适应采集进行联合研究。
AI.method: REACT（上下文和时间的松弛高效采集）采用Gumbel-Sigmoid松弛与直通过估计技术，实现离散采集掩码的梯度优化，直接从预测损失和采集成本进行反向传播
AI.result: 在真实世界的纵向健康和行为数据集上，与现有的纵向采集基线方法相比，REACT以更低的采集成本实现了更好的预测性能
AI.conclusion: 证明了在统一优化框架中建模入职培训和 временно耦合采集的益处

title: CINDI: Conditional Imputation and Noisy Data Integrity with Flows in Power Grid Data
summary: Real-world multivariate time series, particularly in critical infrastructure such as electrical power grids, are often corrupted by noise and anomalies that degrade the performance of downstream tasks. Standard data cleaning approaches often rely on disjoint strategies, which involve detecting errors with one model and imputing them with another. Such approaches can fail to capture the full joint distribution of the data and ignore prediction uncertainty. This work introduces Conditional Imputation and Noisy Data Integrity (CINDI), an unsupervised probabilistic framework designed to restore data integrity in complex time series. Unlike fragmented approaches, CINDI unifies anomaly detection and imputation into a single end-to-end system built on conditional normalizing flows. By modeling the exact conditional likelihood of the data, the framework identifies low-probability segments and iteratively samples statistically consistent replacements. This allows CINDI to efficiently reuse learned information while preserving the underlying physical and statistical properties of the system. We evaluate the framework using real-world grid loss data from a Norwegian power distribution operator, though the methodology is designed to generalize to any multivariate time series domain. The results demonstrate that CINDI yields robust performance compared to competitive baselines, offering a scalable solution for maintaining reliability in noisy environments.

AI.tldr: CINDI is an unsupervised probabilistic framework that uses conditional normalizing flows to jointly perform anomaly detection and imputation in multivariate time series. It unifies traditionally fragmented cleaning approaches into a single end-to-end system, demonstrating robust performance on power grid data while generalizing to other multivariate time series domains.
AI.motivation: Real-world multivariate time series in critical infrastructure (e.g., electrical power grids) are often corrupted by noise and anomalies that degrade downstream task performance. Standard data cleaning approaches use disjoint strategies (separate detection and imputation models), which fail to capture the full joint distribution and ignore prediction uncertainty.
AI.method: CINDI uses conditional normalizing flows to build an unsupervised probabilistic framework that unifies anomaly detection and imputation into a single end-to-end system. It models the exact conditional likelihood of the data, identifies low-probability segments, and iteratively samples statistically consistent replacements while preserving underlying physical and statistical properties.
AI.result: Evaluated using real-world grid loss data from a Norwegian power distribution operator, CINDI yields robust performance compared to competitive baselines.
AI.conclusion: CINDI offers a scalable solution for maintaining reliability in noisy environments. The framework generalizes to any multivariate time series domain and provides robust performance compared to competitive baselines.

title: Ensuring Safety in Automated Mechanical Ventilation through Offline Reinforcement Learning and Digital Twin Verification
summary: Mechanical ventilation (MV) is a life-saving intervention for patients with acute respiratory failure (ARF) in the ICU. However, inappropriate ventilator settings could cause ventilator-induced lung injury (VILI). Also, clinicians workload is shown to be directly linked to patient outcomes. Hence, MV should be personalized and automated to improve patient outcomes. Previous attempts to incorporate personalization and automation in MV include traditional supervised learning and offline reinforcement learning (RL) approaches, which often neglect temporal dependencies and rely excessively on mortality-based rewards. As a result, early stage physiological deterioration and the risk of VILI are not adequately captured. To address these limitations, we propose Transformer-based Conservative Q-Learning (T-CQL), a novel offline RL framework that integrates a Transformer encoder for effective temporal modeling of patient dynamics, conservative adaptive regularization based on uncertainty quantification to ensure safety, and consistency regularization for robust decision-making. We build a clinically informed reward function that incorporates indicators of VILI and a score for severity of patients illness. Also, previous work predominantly uses Fitted Q-Evaluation (FQE) for RL policy evaluation on static offline data, which is less responsive to dynamic environmental changes and susceptible to distribution shifts. To overcome these evaluation limitations, interactive digital twins of ARF patients were used for online "at the bedside" evaluation. Our results demonstrate that T-CQL consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art offline RL methodologies, providing safer and more effective ventilatory adjustments. Our framework demonstrates the potential of Transformer-based models combined with conservative RL strategies as a decision support tool in critical care.

AI.tldr: 针对ICU机械通气个性化自动化需求，提出T-CQL离线RL框架，利用Transformer编码器建模患者时间动态，结合基于不确定性的保守正则化和一致性正则化，使用临床知情奖励函数和交互式数字孪生评估，在通气调整安全性和有效性上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: ICU中的机械通气(MV)是不当设置可能导致呼吸机相关肺损伤(VILI)；先前方法依赖传统监督学习和离线强化学习(RL)，存在忽视时间依赖性、过度依赖死亡率奖励等问题，无法充分捕捉早期生理恶化和VILI风险；现有离线策略评估方法FQE对动态环境变化响应不足且易受分布偏移影响。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为T-CQL的新型离线RL框架，该框架包含：1) Transformer编码器用于患者动态的时间建模；2) 基于不确定性量化的保守自适应正则化以确保安全；3) 用于稳健决策的一致性正则化。同时构建了包含VILI指标和患者疾病严重程度评分的临床知情奖励函数，并使用ARF患者的交互式数字孪生进行在线床旁评估。
AI.result: T-CQL始终优于现有的最先进的离线RL方法，能够提供更安全、更有效的通气调整。
AI.conclusion: T-CQL作为离线RL框架，结合Transformer编码器和保守自适应正则化，能够提供更安全、更有效的通气调整策略，展示了基于Transformer的模型与保守RL策略相结合作为危重症护理决策支持工具的潜力。

title: Anomaly detection in time-series via inductive biases in the latent space of conditional normalizing flows
summary: Deep generative models for anomaly detection in multivariate time-series are typically trained by maximizing data likelihood. However, likelihood in observation space measures marginal density rather than conformity to structured temporal dynamics, and therefore can assign high probability to anomalous or out-of-distribution samples. We address this structural limitation by relocating the notion of anomaly to a prescribed latent space. We introduce explicit inductive biases in conditional normalizing flows, modeling time-series observations within a discrete-time state-space framework that constrains latent representations to evolve according to prescribed temporal dynamics. Under this formulation, expected behavior corresponds to compliance with a specified distribution over latent trajectories, while anomalies are defined as violations of these dynamics. Anomaly detection is consequently reduced to a statistically grounded compliance test, such that observations are mapped to latent space and evaluated via goodness-of-fit tests against the prescribed latent evolution. This yields a principled decision rule that remains effective even in regions of high observation likelihood. Experiments on synthetic and real-world time-series demonstrate reliable detection of anomalies in frequency, amplitude, and observation noise, while providing interpretable diagnostics of model compliance.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于条件归一化流和状态空间模型的多元时间序列异常检测方法，将异常定义从观测空间迁移到潜在空间，通过检验潜在轨迹是否符合预定动态来检测异常。
AI.motivation: 现有深度生成模型通过最大化数据似然进行异常检测，但似然衡量的是边缘密度而非时间动态一致性，导致高似然区域可能包含异常样本，存在结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 1) 使用条件归一化流建模离散时间状态空间框架；2) 将潜在表示约束为符合预定时间动态演变；3) 将异常检测转化为潜在轨迹的拟合优度检验问题。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实世界时间序列上实现了对频率、振幅和观测噪声异常的可靠检测，并能提供模型合规性的可解释诊断。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在观测高似然区域仍保持有效性，提供了一种原则性的决策规则，将异常定义从观测空间迁移到潜在空间从根本上解决了边际密度度量的问题。

title: ARROW: Augmented Replay for RObust World models
summary: Continual reinforcement learning challenges agents to acquire new skills while retaining previously learned ones with the goal of improving performance in both past and future tasks. Most existing approaches rely on model-free methods with replay buffers to mitigate catastrophic forgetting; however, these solutions often face significant scalability challenges due to large memory demands. Drawing inspiration from neuroscience, where the brain replays experiences to a predictive World Model rather than directly to the policy, we present ARROW (Augmented Replay for RObust World models), a model-based continual RL algorithm that extends DreamerV3 with a memory-efficient, distribution-matching replay buffer. Unlike standard fixed-size FIFO buffers, ARROW maintains two complementary buffers: a short-term buffer for recent experiences and a long-term buffer that preserves task diversity through intelligent sampling. We evaluate ARROW on two challenging continual RL settings: Tasks without shared structure (Atari), and tasks with shared structure, where knowledge transfer is possible (Procgen CoinRun variants). Compared to model-free and model-based baselines with replay buffers of the same-size, ARROW demonstrates substantially less forgetting on tasks without shared structure, while maintaining comparable forward transfer. Our findings highlight the potential of model-based RL and bio-inspired approaches for continual reinforcement learning, warranting further research.

AI.tldr: ARROW是一种受神经科学启发的基于模型的持续强化学习算法，通过引入双缓冲机制（短期缓冲区和长期缓冲区）来平衡近期经验保留与任务多样性，在保持与模型无关方法相同内存开销的情况下，显著减少了无共享结构任务中的灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有持续强化学习方法主要依赖模型无关方法配合回放缓冲区来缓解灾难性遗忘，但这些方案面临严重的可扩展性挑战，因为需要大量内存资源。神经科学中发现大脑是将经验回放给预测性世界模型而非直接回放给策略，这一启发送生了本研究的提出。
AI.method: ARROW扩展了DreamerV3，采用记忆高效的分布匹配回放缓冲区，维护两个互补缓冲区：短期缓冲区保存近期经验，长期缓冲区通过智能采样保留任务多样性。算法在两个具有挑战性的持续RL设置中进行评估：无共享结构的任务（Atari）和有共享结构的任务（Procgen CoinRun变体）。
AI.result: 与相同大小的回放缓冲区的模型无关和基于模型的基线方法相比，ARROW在无共享结构任务上展现出显著更少的遗忘，同时保持相当的向前迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果凸显了基于模型的RL和生物启发方法在持续强化学习中的潜力，为进一步研究提供了有力支持。模型-based方法结合受神经科学启发的回放策略是解决持续学习内存效率问题的有效途径。

title: Understanding Wikidata Qualifiers: An Analysis and Taxonomy
summary: This paper presents an in-depth analysis of Wikidata qualifiers, focusing on their semantics and actual usage, with the aim of developing a taxonomy that addresses the challenges of selecting appropriate qualifiers, querying the graph, and making logical inferences. The study evaluates qualifier importance based on frequency and diversity, using a modified Shannon entropy index to account for the "long tail" phenomenon. By analyzing a Wikidata dump, the top 300 qualifiers were selected and categorized into a refined taxonomy that includes contextual, epistemic/uncertainty, structural, and additional qualifiers. The taxonomy aims to guide contributors in creating and querying statements, improve qualifier recommendation systems, and enhance knowledge graph design methodologies. The results show that the taxonomy effectively covers the most important qualifiers and provides a structured approach to understanding and utilizing qualifiers in Wikidata.

AI.tldr: 本文对Wikidata限定符的语义和实际使用进行了深入分析，旨在开发一种分类法以解决限定符选择、图查询和逻辑推理的挑战。研究基于频率和多样性评估限定符重要性，使用修正香农熵指数处理长尾现象，从Wikidata转储中筛选出前300个限定符，并将其分为情境性、认识论/不确定性、结构性和附加性四类。该分类法可指导贡献者创建和查询语句，改进限定符推荐系统，并增强知识图谱设计方法论。
AI.motivation: Wikidata限定符在选择、查询图数据和逻辑推理方面存在挑战，亟需一个系统性的分类法来指导贡献者创建和查询语句，提升知识图谱设计方法。
AI.method: 基于频率和多样性的限定符重要性评估，使用修正的香农熵指数处理"长尾"现象，分析Wikidata数据转储，筛选前300个限定符并归入细化的分类法体系。
AI.result: 建立了包含情境性、认识论/不确定性、结构性和附加性四类限定符的细化分类法，有效覆盖最重要的限定符，为理解和使用Wikidata限定符提供了结构化方法。
AI.conclusion: 该分类法有效覆盖了最重要的限定符，并为理解和利用Wikidata限定符提供了结构化方法。该研究为知识图谱设计方法论提供了新的视角，有助于改进限定符推荐系统和查询逻辑推理能力。

title: Harnessing Data Asymmetry: Manifold Learning in the Finsler World
summary: Manifold learning is a fundamental task at the core of data analysis and visualisation. It aims to capture the simple underlying structure of complex high-dimensional data by preserving pairwise dissimilarities in low-dimensional embeddings. Traditional methods rely on symmetric Riemannian geometry, thus forcing symmetric dissimilarities and embedding spaces, e.g. Euclidean. However, this discards in practice valuable asymmetric information inherent to the non-uniformity of data samples. We suggest to harness this asymmetry by switching to Finsler geometry, an asymmetric generalisation of Riemannian geometry, and propose a Finsler manifold learning pipeline that constructs asymmetric dissimilarities and embeds in a Finsler space. This greatly broadens the applicability of existing asymmetric embedders beyond traditionally directed data to any data. We also modernise asymmetric embedders by generalising current reference methods to asymmetry, like Finsler t-SNE and Finsler Umap. On controlled synthetic and large real datasets, we show that our asymmetric pipeline reveals valuable information lost in the traditional pipeline, e.g. density hierarchies, and consistently provides superior quality embeddings than their Euclidean counterparts.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于芬斯勒几何的流形学习pipeline，将传统对称的黎曼几何替换为非对称的芬斯勒几何，以保留数据中的非对称 dissimilarities信息，并相应地推广了t-SNE和UMAP等方法形成Finsler版本，在合成和真实数据集上展示了更优的嵌入质量。
AI.motivation: 传统流形学习方法依赖对称的黎曼几何，强制要求 dissimilarities 和嵌入空间对称，这丢弃了数据中固有的有价值的不对称信息（如数据样本的非均匀性）。
AI.method: 提出芬斯勒流形学习pipeline：1）构建非对称 dissimilarities；2）在芬斯勒空间中进行嵌入。同时将现有参考方法推广到非对称版本，包括 Finsler t-SNE 和 Finsler UMAP。
AI.result: 在受控合成数据集和大型真实数据集上，非对称 pipeline 能够揭示传统方法丢失的有价值信息（如密度层级），且一致地提供优于欧几里得对应方法的嵌入质量。
AI.conclusion: 芬斯勒几何为流形学习提供了一种有价值的非对称推广框架，能够捕获传统对称方法忽略的信息，可应用于任意数据而不仅限于传统有向数据。

title: Governing Evolving Memory in LLM Agents: Risks, Mechanisms, and the Stability and Safety Governed Memory (SSGM) Framework
summary: Long-term memory has emerged as a foundational component of autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents, enabling continuous adaptation, lifelong multimodal learning, and sophisticated reasoning. However, as memory systems transition from static retrieval databases to dynamic, agentic mechanisms, critical concerns regarding memory governance, semantic drift, and privacy vulnerabilities have surfaced. While recent surveys have focused extensively on memory retrieval efficiency, they largely overlook the emergent risks of memory corruption in highly dynamic environments. To address these emerging challenges, we propose the Stability and Safety-Governed Memory (SSGM) framework, a conceptual governance architecture. SSGM decouples memory evolution from execution by enforcing consistency verification, temporal decay modeling, and dynamic access control prior to any memory consolidation. Through formal analysis and architectural decomposition, we show how SSGM can mitigate topology-induced knowledge leakage where sensitive contexts are solidified into long-term storage, and help prevent semantic drift where knowledge degrades through iterative summarization. Ultimately, this work provides a comprehensive taxonomy of memory corruption risks and establishes a robust governance paradigm for deploying safe, persistent, and reliable agentic memory systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Stability and Safety-Governed Memory (SSGM)框架，解决大型语言模型智能体中动态记忆系统的稳定性与安全问题。SSGM通过解耦记忆演化与执行过程，在记忆整合前实施一致性验证、时间衰减建模和动态访问控制，防范知识泄露和语义漂移。
AI.motivation: 随着记忆系统从静态检索数据库向动态智能机制转变，关键问题浮现：记忆治理、语义漂移和隐私漏洞。现有关于记忆检索效率的调查忽视了动态环境中记忆腐化的新兴风险。
AI.method: 提出SSGM框架——一种概念治理架构。核心机制包括：1)一致性验证；2)时间衰减建模；3)动态访问控制。通过形式化分析和架构分解展示框架效果。
AI.result: SSGM可缓解拓扑诱导的知识泄露（敏感上下文被固化为长期存储），并防止语义漂移（知识在迭代摘要中退化）。
AI.conclusion: 建立了记忆腐化风险的全面分类法，为部署安全、持久、可靠的智能记忆系统确立了稳健的治理范式。

title: A Stable Neural Statistical Dependence Estimator for Autoencoder Feature Analysis
summary: Statistical dependence measures like mutual information is ideal for analyzing autoencoders, but it can be ill-posed for deterministic, static, noise-free networks. We adopt the variational (Gaussian) formulation that makes dependence among inputs, latents, and reconstructions measurable, and we propose a stable neural dependence estimator based on an orthonormal density-ratio decomposition. Unlike MINE, our method avoids input concatenation and product-of-marginals re-pairing, reducing computational cost and improving stability. We introduce an efficient NMF-like scalar objective and demonstrate empirically that assuming Gaussian noise to form an auxiliary variable enables meaningful dependence measurements and supports quantitative feature analysis, with a sequential convergence of singular values.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自编码器特征分析中"统计依赖度（如互信息）在确定性、无噪声静态网络下不可测"的问题，采用变分（高斯）假设使依赖度良定义，并提出基于密度比正交分解的稳定神经依赖度估计器：用一个受NMF启发的标量代价 c = (E[Σ_k f_k(X)g_k(Y)])² / Σ_{i,j}(R_F ⊙ R_G)_{i,j} 替代 MINE 的拼接输入与边缘重配对，从而避免 N² 重配对开销、消除矩阵求逆与 log-det 需求、训练更稳定；实验（two-moons、MNIST）表明该估计器给出无偏的 Rényi 互信息估计，并可定量刻画数据—特征—重构之间的依赖关系、奇异值谱与奇异函数，并支持仅用编码器（加高斯噪声）的特征学习。
AI.motivation: 把统计依赖度（尤其是互信息）用于分析级联编码器—解码器（自编码器）是通信/信息论中的常见做法，且有结论表明最小化重构 MSE 等价于最大化输入与中间变量间的互信息。然而作者指出核心障碍：对静态端到端确定性网络，若不加噪声，输入与输出之间的统计依赖未定义且不可测，直接套用估计器是病态的（ill-posed）；同时 MINE 类估计器因把 X、Y 拼接输入并用批内重配对来近似"边缘乘积"下的期望，产生 O(N²) 计算量与严重不稳定性。论文动机即：(1) 通过变分贝叶斯/高斯假设让依赖度良定义；(2) 构造比 MINE 更稳定、更高效、可扩展的神经依赖度估计器；(3) 用它做自编码器特征的定量分析与解释性工具（奇异值/奇异函数），并进一步探索"仅最大化统计依赖即可学特征"。
AI.method: 核心方法分三部分。(1) 密度比的正交分解：把 p(X,Y)/(p(X)p(Y)) 展开为 Σ_k √λ_k · φ̂_k(X) ψ̂_k(Y)，奇异值 ∈[0,1]，全为 0 当且仅当独立；用两个多输出（K 路）网络 f、g 分别逼近左右奇异函数，无需输入拼接，也无需边缘重配对。(2) 新的 NMF 型标量代价：由 Cauchy–Schwarz 不等式得 (E[Σ_k f_k(X)g_k(Y)])² / Σ_{i,j} E[f_i f_j]E[g_i g_j] ≤ ∬p²/(p p) dXdY（即 Rényi 阶 2 互信息），分母可写成 Σ_{i,j}(R_F ⊙ R_G)_{i,j}（Hadamard 积）；用 ReLU 保证输出非负，只需 R_F、R_G 自相关矩阵与一个联合期望，代价中无矩阵求逆、无 log-det、无其梯度，分母加 ε=1e-6 稳定；最大化 c 或 log c。附录给出完整证明（并复证先前的 log-det 与 trace 代价等价于奇异函数分解，白化+旋转+SVD 提取奇异值/奇异函数）。(3) 用于自编码器：变分目标 max ∫p(X)p(Y|X) log q(X|Y)，取 p(Y|X)=N(Y;E(X),v_p)、q(X|Y)=N(X;D(Y),v_q)；推导 v_q 最优值等于经验 MSE（对高斯负对数似然求导），v_p 通过三条经验证据（训练中重构由粗到细的阶段性过渡、Nyström 离散化的 Markov 矩阵扫描、加上 v_p 后依赖估计才稳定）定在 10⁻⁵~10⁻⁶ 量级。定义 Y′=Y+√v_p·noise、X̂′=X̂+√v_q·noise，度量 {X,Y′}、{Y,Y′}、{Y′,X̂′}、{X̂,X̂′}、{X,X̂′} 等各对的依赖度；发现"替代模式"：用 Y 替代 X、用 X̂′ 替代 Y′ 依赖度不衰减。实验用 two-moons 与 MNIST，对比 NMF-DR（K=2000）、LOGDET/TRACE（K=50 或 500）、MINE、KDE/KICA/HSIC；附录还给出 KDE 代价与神经 NMF 代价两种"仅编码器最大化依赖度"的特征学习方案，以及 Nyström 式离散等价分析（含混合解码器 + 输入高斯平滑修复编码器/解码器奇异谱间隙）。
AI.result: (1) 三种代价（NMF-DR/LOGDET/TRACE）给出彼此一致且无偏的 Rényi 互信息估计，NMF-DR 最高效可扩展（K=2000 仍稳定；LOGDET/TRACE 在 K 远大于正奇异值个数时出现偏差，需增大维度到 500 代价高昂）。(2) 替代模式一致成立：two-moons 上 (X,Y′)≈(Y,Y′)≈28.6、(Y′,X̂′)≈(X̂,X̂′)≈22.4，而 (X,X̂′) 最低（16.6）；MNIST 上编码器侧 ~28.8、解码器侧随维度变化（1D 时 ~200，维度增大至 1886）。MINE 完全看不出这些规律（数值 1.85–4.90），学习曲线有明显"凹陷"；本文代价曲线平滑稳定。核方法（KDE/KICA/HSIC）仅作参考。(3) 噪声扫描：v_p 从 1e-7 到 1e-1，MSE 升高、依赖度单调衰减，但替代模式始终成立；两数据集的编码器侧依赖度随 v_p 的变化曲线高度一致（主要由 v_p 与特征维度决定，与数据集基本无关）。(4) 训练迭代扫描：依赖度从初始值 1（独立下界）随训练进行单调上升，且每个迭代点替代模式都成立，支持"MSE 下降=高斯球收缩、依赖度上升"的解释。(5) 奇异谱：噪声自由情形下奇异值全部饱和到 1（病态）；给定 v_p 后谱分布在 [0,1] 内，说明估计无偏；奇异函数呈 Hermite 多项式样（与高斯噪声假设一致），主奇异函数与 MNIST 类别结构相关，特征空间被"低频/高频"方式划分。(6) 同构性可视化：{Y,Y′} 与 {X,X̂} 诱导的密度比度量矩阵视觉上高度相似，支持二者同构；估计器输出极度稀疏。(7) 附录 E 的定量评估：完全确定性设置下初始化时依赖度已达 ~1500（MINE 约 1.15），说明病态源于"样本空间相对估计器分辨率过于离散"；KDE/网格/神经估计器均呈"先升后降"的非单调偏差曲线，样本量足够时趋于下界 1；拼接输入均匀噪声可使初始化值回到 ~1（two-moons 上训练后仅 ~60 而非 ~1500），但在 MNIST 上后期仍升至 ~1900，改善有限；随机小批量优化（batch 5000）可把 MNIST 值降到 ~1000。(8) 特征学习：KDE 代价与神经 NMF 代价均可在无解码器情况下学出与端到端自编码器相似的 MNIST 特征投影；奇异值随训练逐次（顺序）上升；混合解码器+输入高斯平滑可消除编码器/解码器奇异谱间隙，二者谱与奇异函数完全对齐（解码器成为编码器的逆映射）。
AI.conclusion: 在变分高斯假设下，自编码器的输入、特征与重构之间的统计依赖是可定义且可有意义估计的；本文提出的基于密度比正交分解与 NMF 型标量代价的神经估计器，在无偏性、效率与稳定性上优于 MINE，并支持对自编码器（乃至任意前馈网络各层）依赖结构的定量分析（依赖矩阵、奇异谱、奇异函数、度量同构性）。实践要点：必须引入每步重采样的噪声（特征加性高斯噪声或输入拼接噪声）并保证样本量与估计器输出维度的匹配，否则依赖度会被严重高估；估计 log 形式代价并加入 ε 更稳定。同时，作者坦承局限：该方法估计的是去掉 log 的阶 2 Rényi 互信息而非 Shannon 互信息；v_p 的存在与取值主要依赖经验证据；v_p 有效值与样本空间分辨率/网格精度绑定；估计器存在分辨率诱导的偏差，拼接输入噪声在 MNIST 上后期仍不足；特征学习需对数据也加高斯噪声且代价较高，奇异函数可解释性仍待深入。

title: An Automatic Text Classification Method Based on Hierarchical Taxonomies, Neural Networks and Document Embedding: The NETHIC Tool
summary: This work describes an automatic text classification method implemented in a software tool called NETHIC, which takes advantage of the inner capabilities of highly-scalable neural networks combined with the expressiveness of hierarchical taxonomies. As such, NETHIC succeeds in bringing about a mechanism for text classification that proves to be significantly effective as well as efficient. The tool had undergone an experimentation process against both a generic and a domain-specific corpus, outputting promising results. On the basis of this experimentation, NETHIC has been now further refined and extended by adding a document embedding mechanism, which has shown improvements in terms of performance on the individual networks and on the whole hierarchical model.

AI.tldr: NETHIC是一个结合层次化分类体系（RDF/SKOS本体）、人工神经网络（多层感知机）与Doc2Vec文档嵌入的自动文本分类软件工具；本论文在其早期BOW版本基础上引入BOW+Doc2Vec融合特征，在Wikipedia构建的57,304篇文档语料上取得约2%的整体准确率提升，并系统对比了三种特征方案与层级路径构建算法。
AI.motivation: 网络文本信息量爆炸式增长，传统单一分类器面对语义相近的大量类别时噪声大、易混淆。NETHIC早期版本仅使用词袋（BOW）特征，本文的动机是：单纯BOW难以捕捉文档语义（尤其难以区分同一中间类下的近义叶节点），而单独使用Doc2Vec又会丢失词频信息，因此需要将层次分类体系的结构化先验与文档语义嵌入结合，在不显著增加计算开销的前提下提升分类精度，并验证该扩展在通用语料与层级整体模型上均有效。
AI.method: 方法为“层次分类体系 + 人工神经网络 + 文档嵌入”的三层结合。（1）知识模型：以RDF定义通用层次分类法（root→21个一级子类别→共117个叶类别，树深2），通过SKOS的skos:exactMatch/skos:majorMatch将叶类别手工连接到Wikipedia类别图。（2）语料构建：从Wikipedia的Main_topic_classifications递归抓取约150万节点、含子类关系的图；用词嵌入为节点生成向量，边权=向量余弦相似度的inverse；再从叶类别出发沿最短语义路径收集文档，组织成与分类法同构的目录结构，得到57,304篇文档；按95%/5%切分为Corpus-A（54,439篇，训练/单网络验证）与Corpus-B（2,843篇，层级整体验证，约每叶类25篇）。（3）三种ETL特征变换：构建BOW数据集、Doc2Vec（300维）数据集、BOW+Doc2Vec拼接数据集，每种变换生成18个数据集。（4）训练：对每个非叶分类法概念训练一个ANN并配一个词典；采用k折交叉验证（4折训练+1折验证）配合留一法测试（伪代码Algorithm 1），验证无过拟合/欠拟合后用全训练集拟合模型，输出准确率、精确率、召回率、F1。（5）推理：文本经词典与Doc2Vec向量化为BOW+D2V复合向量输入root网络，按阈值0.7迭代下钻至更深层网络，每条路径得分为各层分数均值，取前三条路径为结果；词典按路径逐步替换以保持语义一致性。技术栈为Python + scikit-learn（CountVectorizer、MLP）、Gensim、pickle。
AI.result: 单网络层面：BOW+Doc2Vec组合模型准确率最优，多数类别较BOW提升约2%，root类别提升约1%（root权重最大，对层级路径正确构建尤为关键）；单独Doc2Vec表现最差，说明仅靠文档嵌入不足以表示此类细粒度分类，但可作为BOW的有效补充。层级模型层面：NETHIC-2较原NETHIC多正确分类约60篇文档，整体提升约2%；root层混淆矩阵中Science多正确约8篇，Art and Entertainment与Society的混淆减少，Health_and_fitness不再大量与Society、Sport、Food_and_drink混判；计算开销基本不变（新增300维向量不改变特征向量数量级）。实例：Bukovskyite文档正确归入business_and_industrial/iron_and_steel_industry（0.68）与science/geology（0.53）；Overeaters Anonymous文档正确给出food_and_drink/healthy_eating并意外命中health_and_fitness/addiction（0.64）。
AI.conclusion: 结论部分指出：层次分类体系与人工神经网络的组合已被证明在文本分类上有效，具备良好的可扩展性与模块化；引入Doc2Vec这一SOTA NLP技术与BOW融合后，以略微增加维度为代价即获得更好的分类结果，因此推荐二者结合使用。单独BOW已足够稳健，但不建议单独使用Doc2Vec（缺乏词频信息时难以区分近义叶类别）。未来工作方向是集成或扩展BERT等更先进的方法。本文的局限在于评测仅基于Wikipedia通用语料与层级体系，领域特定任务（此前用于识别网络犯罪内容的项目）未在本研究中重新验证，且总体绝对准确率仍有限。

title: ZTab: Domain-based Zero-shot Annotation for Table Columns
summary: This study addresses the challenge of automatically detecting semantic column types in relational tables, a key task in many real-world applications. Zero-shot modeling eliminates the need for user-provided labeled training data, making it ideal for scenarios where data collection is costly or restricted due to privacy concerns. However, existing zero-shot models suffer from poor performance when the number of semantic column types is large, limited understanding of tabular structure, and privacy risks arising from dependence on high-performance closed-source LLMs. We introduce ZTab, a domain-based zero-shot framework that addresses both performance and zero-shot requirements. Given a domain configuration consisting of a set of predefined semantic types and sample table schemas, ZTab generates pseudo-tables for the sample schemas and fine-tunes an annotation LLM on them. ZTab is domain-based zero-shot in that it does not depend on user-specific labeled training data; therefore, no retraining is needed for a test table from a similar domain. We describe three cases of domain-based zero-shot. The domain configuration of ZTab provides a trade-off between the extent of zero-shot and annotation performance: a "universal domain" that contains all semantic types approaches "pure" zero-shot, while a "specialized domain" that contains semantic types for a specific application enables better zero-shot performance within that domain. Source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/hoseinzadeehsan/ZTab

AI.tldr: 本文提出ZTab框架，用于关系表语义列类型的零样本检测。该框架通过领域配置（预定义语义类型+样本模式）生成伪表并微调LLM，在不依赖用户标注数据的前提下实现自动语义列类型识别，并提供通用领域与专门领域两种配置以平衡零样本程度与性能。
AI.motivation: 自动检测关系表中语义列类型是许多实际应用中的关键任务。现有零样本模型在语义列类型数量大时性能较差，对表格结构理解有限，且依赖高性能闭源LLM存在隐私风险。纯零样本方法缺乏用户提供的标注训练数据，在数据收集成本高或因隐私问题受限的场景中理想但性能不足。
AI.method: 提出ZTab，一个基于领域的零样本框架。该框架利用领域配置（包含预定义语义类型集合和样本表模式），为样本模式生成伪表，并在伪表上微调注释LLM。ZTab不依赖用户特定标注训练数据，因此无需为相似领域的测试表进行重新训练。通过"通用领域"（包含所有语义类型，接近纯零样本）和"专门领域"（针对特定应用的语义类型）提供零样本程度与注释性能之间的权衡。
AI.result: ZTab能够在不需要用户标注数据的情况下，对关系表进行语义列类型检测。通过领域配置实现零样本要求与注释性能之间的权衡，通用领域更接近纯零样本，专门领域则在特定应用域内实现更好的零样本性能。
AI.conclusion: ZTab有效解决了语义列类型检测中的性能与零样本需求矛盾，通过领域配置方式在隐私保护前提下实现灵活的性能-零样本程度权衡。

title: UniHetCO: A Unified Heterogeneous Representation for Multi-Problem Learning in Unsupervised Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Unsupervised neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) offers an appealing alternative to supervised approaches by training learning-based solvers without ground-truth solutions, directly minimizing instance objectives and constraint violations. Yet for graph node subset-selection problems (e.g., Maximum Clique and Maximum Independent Set), existing unsupervised methods are typically specialized to a single problem class and rely on problem-specific surrogate losses, which hinders learning across classes within a unified framework. In this work, we propose UniHetCO, a unified heterogeneous graph representation for constrained quadratic programming-based combinatorial optimization that encodes problem structure, objective terms, and linear constraints in a single input. This formulation enables training a single model across multiple problem classes with a unified label-free objective. To improve stability under multi-problem learning, we employ a gradient-norm-based dynamic weighting scheme that alleviates gradient imbalance among classes. Experiments on multiple datasets and four constrained problem classes demonstrate competitive performance with state-of-the-art unsupervised NCO baselines, strong cross-problem adaptation potential, and effective warm starts for a commercial classical solver under tight time limits.

AI.tldr: UniHetCO 提出了一种统一的异构图表示，将图上节点子集选择类组合优化（QP/QUBO 形式）的目标项与线性约束一并编码进网络输入，配合统一的免标签（无监督）QUBO 损失和基于梯度范数的动态域加权，使单一模型可同时求解 MIS、MC、MVC、MDS 等多类问题，并在跨问题泛化与为 Gurobi 提供 warm start 方面展现出潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督神经组合优化（NCO）方法几乎都是"单问题专用"的：每个问题类都需要自己设计代理损失（surrogate loss），无法在一个统一框架内联合训练不同问题类。同时，工程实践中目标函数与约束常常随实例或时间变化，为每种公式维护独立模型成本高昂。作者指出，针对节点子集选择类问题（最大团 MIS/MC、最小点覆盖 MVC、最小支配集 MDS），不同类之间不仅架构不同，更缺乏共享的训练目标；同时这些类都可统一归约为带线性约束的二次规划（QP），进而转成 QUBO，为"通用求解器"提供了可能。作者将每个问题类视为一个域，把设置自然地纳入多域学习（multi-domain learning）与域泛化框架，并指出朴素 ERM 联合训练会因各问题 QUBO 目标量级差异巨大而产生严重的梯度失衡。
AI.method: 1) 统一异构图表示：把一般 QP 的问题结构图 G_prob（变量节点 + 原图边）、目标图 G_obj（Q 的非对角二次耦合边 + 对角自环吸收线性项 c，权重取 Q_ij 与 Q_ii+c_i）、约束超图 G_constr 统一编码为一个异构二部图：所有 ≥ 型不等式统一转成 ≤ 型（乘 -1），每条约束引入一个约束节点，边权为 A 的系数 a_ej，节点特征为右端项 b_e。由此 MIS/MC/MVC/MDS 都可写成同一形式。2) 统一无监督损失：min 目标二次项（对角用 x_i^2）+ λ_constr·Σ_e max(0, Σ_j a_ej x_j − b_e) 的 hinge 约束惩罚，λ_obj=λ_constr=1；模型输出松弛解 x_r∈[0,1]^N，推理时用问题专用贪心解码（MIS/MC 按分数降序贪心可行性添加；MVC 先贪心覆盖再剪枝；MDS 贪心支配后剪枝）。3) 异构 GNN 架构：三条关系独立的消息传递通道——GINConv 用于问题图，Graph-Conv 用于目标图与约束二部图；变量节点嵌入拼接后经 FCN + 归一化得到选择概率。4) 多问题训练采用梯度范数动态加权（GradNorm 简化版）：w_k = 平均梯度范数 / (第 k 域梯度范数 + ε)，权重 detach 作为常数，避免高阶梯度，实现单次稳定反向传播；对比 ERM、静态权重（SW）两个变体。
AI.result: RQ1 单问题设置：在 IMDB/COLLAB/Twitter/RB200 上与 EGN、Meta-EGN、贪心、Gurobi（0.2–4s）对比，UniHetCO 与 SOTA 无监督基线相当；难数据集上优于 EGN（Twitter、RB200 的 MC/MVC），RB200 上 MC 比 Meta-EGN 高 1.4%、MVC 取得最优。RQ2 多问题（K=4）：同源图上多问题训练略逊于单问题（Twitter MC 约降 4%），DW 在 MDS 上稳定小幅提升，SW 在 RB200 的 MIS 上大幅提升；异构图（SparseSuit，Musketeer 生成 900 图）上 DW 在 MIS/MVC 上有竞争力，但 MC 退化约 9%、MDS 退化约 5%，ERM 则 MIS 下降 10%。RQ3 跨问题泛化：留一法在 Twitter 上，MC 零样本 0.5304 经一步微调升至 0.9072、进一步微调 0.9182；MIS 改善有限（0.8034→0.8264），MVC 对微调不敏感（AR≈1.18–1.19）；MDS 的泛化甚至优于单问题模型，说明迁移性依赖问题结构。RQ4 warm start：将松弛解作为 MIP start 喂给 Gurobi（0.2s 上限）求解 MC，在 Twitter/RB200/SparseSuit 上一致改进最优目标值，Single 最强、DW 有小幅正增益。
AI.conclusion: UniHetCO 首次在无监督 NCO 中通过异构图表示统一了多类问题的目标与约束，使单一模型可在统一免标签损失下跨问题类训练，并具备跨问题迁移与为商业求解器 warm start 的实用价值。作者同时明确两点局限：非局部/高基数约束（如覆盖、支配约束）必须显式展开为约束节点与稠密连接，导致图规模与消息传递开销膨胀，限制可扩展性；多问题优化对 QUBO 目标与惩罚项的相对尺度敏感，动态加权只能缓解而非消除梯度失衡，未来需引入更规范化的归一化与尺度不变目标。

title: DocSage: An Information Structuring Agent for Multi-Doc Multi-Entity Question Answering
summary: Multi-document Multi-entity Question Answering inherently demands models to track implicit logic between multiple entities across scattered documents. However, existing Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks suffer from critical limitations: standard RAG's vector similarity-based coarse-grained retrieval often omits critical facts, graph-based RAG fails to efficiently integrate fragmented complex relationship networks, and both lack schema awareness, leading to inadequate cross-document evidence chain construction and inaccurate entity relationship deduction. To address these challenges, we propose DocSage, an end-to-end agentic framework that integrates dynamic schema discovery, structured information extraction, and schema-aware relational reasoning with error guarantees. DocSage operates through three core modules: (1) A schema discovery module dynamically infers query-specific minimal joinable schemas to capture essential entities and relationships; (2) An extraction module transforms unstructured text into semantically coherent relational tables, enhanced by error-aware correction mechanisms to reduce extraction errors; (3) A reasoning module performs multi-hop relational reasoning over structured tables, leveraging schema awareness to efficiently align cross-document entities and aggregate evidence. This agentic design offers three key advantages: precise fact localization via SQL-powered indexing, natural support for cross-document entity joins through relational tables, and mitigated LLM attention diffusion via structured representation. Evaluations on two MDMEQA benchmarks demonstrate that DocSage significantly outperforms state-of-the-art long-context LLMs and RAG systems, achieving more than 27% accuracy improvements respectively.

AI.tldr: DocSage 是一个面向多文档多实体问答（MDMEQA）的端到端智能体框架：先交互式推断查询专用的最小可连接关系模式（ASK），再把非结构化文档抽取为关系表并做逻辑一致性纠错（CLEAR，含共形预测置信度），最后用 schema 感知的 SQL 编译与多跳关系推理生成带溯源证据的答案。在 MEBench 与 Loong 两个基准上整体准确率 89.2%（较最佳基线 GPT-4o+RAG 提升 27.2 个百分点）与 Loong Overall 68.29/Perfect Rate 0.53，且对实体数量与文档长度增长最鲁棒。
AI.motivation: MDMEQA 要求模型在分散的多份文档中定位事实、建立跨文档实体对齐并构造连贯证据链。现有方法存在三类根本缺陷：长上下文 LLM 受上下文窗口与注意力扩散（contextual dilution）影响，会遗漏关键实体关系；标准 RAG 基于向量相似度的粗粒度检索，优先语义重叠而非实体相关性，常漏掉跨文档推理所需的关键事实；GraphRAG 等图式方法虽改善多跳推理但难以高效整合跨文档碎片化关系网络，且图构建随文档量增长而计算代价高昂。统一缺陷是缺乏 schema 感知：无针对查询的显式结构化表示，导致证据链割裂、实体推断错误。
AI.method: 三模块串联的智能体流水线。①交互式 Schema 发现（ASK）：用 schema 派生 LLM 从查询与样本文档生成初始模式假设 S0^q；将模式应用到更多文档后检测三类不确定性信号——实体对齐冲突、属性值分布异常（如 Age=180）、缺失的多跳关系；由问题生成器针对每类信号产出澄清问题 P，用这些“问题”作为查询在全集中做定向检索，再由更新函数修订/扩展/剪枝模式，直至模式连续迭代稳定或所有问题被充分回答，输出查询专用最小可连接模式 S^q。②逻辑感知结构化抽取（CLEAR）：以 Mistral-7B 抽取候选元组；Level A 针对每个目标模式微调 LoRA 适配器，并用共形预测（conformal prediction）阈值把模型概率校准为置信度 conf；Level B 在临时数据库中定义并校验模式依赖的逻辑约束（函数依赖 Person_ID→Date_of_Birth、时间序 Admission<Discharge、数值范围、外键引用完整性），由轻量约束校验引擎（SLM）标出违规元组；低置信或违规者触发修正——简单遗漏用更强 LLM 委员会重抽取，复杂冲突交由验证与消歧子模块做上下文深析或回溯检索。③Schema 引导关系推理：推理 LLM（GPT-4o）将查询编译为优化 SQL（利用显式连接键做过滤下推与连接顺序选择），执行后对结果行做溯源映射回原始文档片段，再据结果集+溯源链生成最终自然语言答案。核心优势：SQL 索引实现精确定位、关系表原生支持跨文档实体连接、避免注意力扩散。
AI.result: MEBench：DocSage 整体 0.892（Comparison 0.934、Statistics 0.908、Relationship 0.812），较次优 GPT-4o+RAG 的 0.620 提升 27.2 个百分点，较 GraphRAG/StructRAG 提升约 30 个百分点；对实体规模鲁棒，Set1→Set3（>100 实体）仅从 0.918 降至 0.879，而 GPT-4o+RAG 从 0.764 跌至 0.415、StructRAG 降至 0.406。Loong：Overall Avg 68.29 / Perfect Rate 0.53（次优 GPT-4o 0.26），Spotlight 85.06/0.84、Chain of Reason 73.67/0.57；在 200K-250K tokens 最长设置仍保持 Avg 60.52、Perfect 0.47，而基线 Perfect ≤0.10。消融（MEBench）：去掉结构化抽取下降 20.1 点最严重，其次去掉 schema 引导推理 -11.9、去掉 schema 发现 -11.1、去掉 CLEAR 逻辑检查 -4.3、改被动发现 -2.9；Loong 上 schema 发现影响最大（Chain of Reason -13.22），结构化抽取在 Comparison/Clustering 各降约 9.2 点。
AI.conclusion: DocSage 通过把无结构文档语料动态转换为查询专用、带误差保证的关系表示，把 MDMEQA 的碎片化与 schema 稀缺问题转化为可计算的数据库操作，验证了以动态结构归纳为核心的智能体工作流是提升复杂多文档推理与答案精度的有效范式：精确事实定位、无缝跨文档实体连接、稳健多跳推断，并在实体数量与文档长度剧增时保持最稳健的表现。局限：效果与效率依赖底层基座模型能力，迭代式多阶段流程带来不可忽略的计算开销；假设源文档具备一定语义连贯与事实一致性，在极噪声、矛盾或高度专业化文本上可能退化。

title: Bridging Discrete Marks and Continuous Dynamics: Dual-Path Cross-Interaction for Marked Temporal Point Processes
summary: Predicting irregularly spaced event sequences with discrete marks poses significant challenges due to the complex, asynchronous dependencies embedded within continuous-time data streams.Existing sequential approaches capture dependencies among event tokens but ignore the continuous evolution between events, while Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (Neural ODE) methods model smooth dynamics yet fail to account for how event types influence future timing.To overcome these limitations, we propose NEXTPP, a dual-channel framework that unifies discrete and continuous representations via Event-granular Neural Evolution with Cross-Interaction for Marked Temporal Point Processes. Specifically, NEXTPP encodes discrete event marks via a self-attention mechanism, simultaneously evolving a latent continuous-time state using a Neural ODE. These parallel streams are then fused through a crossattention module to enable explicit bidirectional interaction between continuous and discrete representations. The fused representations drive the conditional intensity function of the neural Hawkes process, while an iterative thinning sampler is employed to generate future events. Extensive evaluations on five real-world datasets demonstrate that NEXTPP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models. The source code can be found at https://github.com/AONE-NLP/NEXTPP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NEXTPP框架，通过结合自注意力机制处理离散事件标记和神经ODE建模连续时间动态，并利用交叉注意力模块实现离散与连续表示的双向交互，以改进不规则间隔事件序列的预测。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在局限性：序列方法仅捕捉事件token间的依赖关系而忽略事件间的连续演化；神经ODE方法建模平滑动态但未考虑事件类型对未来时间的影响。因此需要一种统一离散和连续表示的框架来同时建模不规则间隔事件序列的时间和标记信息。
AI.method: 提出NEXTPP（Event-granular Neural Evolution with Cross-Interaction for Marked Temporal Point Processes）双通道框架：1）使用自注意力机制编码离散事件标记；2）使用神经ODE演化潜在连续时间状态；3）通过交叉注意力模块融合两个并行流以实现双向交互；融合后的表示驱动神经Hawkes过程的条件强度函数；4）使用迭代thinning采样器生成未来事件。
AI.result: 在五个真实世界数据集上的广泛评估表明，NEXTPP一致性地优于现有最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: NEXTPP通过有效统一离散和连续表示，成功解决了不规则间隔事件序列预测中的核心挑战，为标记时间点过程建模提供了一种更强大的方法。

title: A Semi-Decentralized Approach to Multiagent Control
summary: We introduce an expressive framework and algorithms for the semi-decentralized control of cooperative agents in environments with communication uncertainty. Whereas semi-Markov control admits a distribution over time for agent actions, semi-Markov communication, or what we refer to as semi-decentralization, gives a distribution over time for what actions and observations agents can store in their histories. We extend semi-decentralization to the partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP). The resulting SDec-POMDP unifies decentralized and multiagent POMDPs and several existing explicit communication mechanisms. We present recursive small-step semi-decentralized A* (RS-SDA*), an exact algorithm for generating optimal SDec-POMDP policies. RS-SDA* is evaluated on semi-decentralized versions of several standard benchmarks and a maritime medical evacuation scenario. This paper provides a well-defined theoretical foundation for exploring many classes of multiagent communication problems through the lens of semi-decentralization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SDec-POMDP框架，统一了去中心化和多智能体POMDP以及现有的显式通信机制，通过RS-SDA*算法实现半去中心化控制，为多智能体通信问题提供了理论基础
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理通信不确定性方面存在局限，文章旨在解决协作智能体在通信不确定环境中的半去中心化控制问题
AI.method: 提出了一种表达性框架和RS-SDA*（递归小步半去中心化A*）算法，这是一种精确算法，用于生成最优的SDec-POMDP策略
AI.result: 在多个标准基准测试和海上医疗疏散场景中验证了算法的有效性
AI.conclusion: 提出了RS-SDA*算法在标准基准问题和海上医疗疏散场景中的有效性验证，展示了半去中心化方法在处理通信不确定性方面的理论优势和应用潜力

title: Slack More, Predict Better: Proximal Relaxation for Probabilistic Latent Variable Model-based Soft Sensors
comment: This paper has been provisionally accepted for publication in the "IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics"
summary: Nonlinear Probabilistic Latent Variable Models (NPLVMs) are a cornerstone of soft sensor modeling due to their capacity for uncertainty delineation. However, conventional NPLVMs are trained using amortized variational inference, where neural networks parameterize the variational posterior. While facilitating model implementation, this parameterization converts the distributional optimization problem within an infinite-dimensional function space to parameter optimization within a finite-dimensional parameter space, which introduces an approximation error gap, thereby degrading soft sensor modeling accuracy. To alleviate this issue, we introduce KProxNPLVM, a novel NPLVM that pivots to relaxing the objective itself and improving the NPLVM's performance. Specifically, we first prove the approximation error induced by the conventional approach. Based on this, we design the Wasserstein distance as the proximal operator to relax the learning objective, yielding a new variational inference strategy derived from solving this relaxed optimization problem. Based on this foundation, we provide a rigorous derivation of KProxNPLVM's optimization implementation, prove the convergence of our algorithm can finally sidestep the approximation error, and propose the KProxNPLVM by summarizing the abovementioned content. Finally, extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world industrial datasets are conducted to demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed KProxNPLVM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 KProxNPLVM：不再优化"摊销变分推断（AVI）下的有限参数化变分后验"，而是把学习目标本身做松弛——用 2-Wasserstein 距离作为近端算子，在 Wasserstein 空间 P2 上对 KL 散度做正则化，并通过 RKHS 正则化的粒子化 proximal 递推（KProx 算法）推断隐变量分布；再以 Sinkhorn-Knopp 最优传输损失训练推断网络，构成完整的 NPLVM 软测量模型。在 DBC/CAC/CSC 三个工业数据集上取得最优或次优的 R²/RMSE/MAE/MAPE，并对多数基线具有统计显著性（p<0.05）。
AI.motivation: 非线性概率隐变量模型（NPLVM）依靠摊销变分推断（AVI）训练，但 AVI 必须用有限维参数化的推断网络 q_φ(z|D) 去表示真实后验 P(z|D)，把无穷维函数空间上的分布优化降为有限维参数优化，由此引入"近似误差地板"。作者在 Lemma 1 中基于指数族（Fisher 信息矩阵 M-Lipschitz + 局部强凸）证明了该误差下界：D_KL[Q_φ||P_θ] ≥ ½[η(φ)-η(θ)]ᵀ I(θ₁)[η(φ)-η(θ)]，即当变分族选错（如真实后验多峰而变分族为单峰高斯）时误差不可消除。工业软测量场景中（NPLVR/DBPSFA/MUDVAE-SDVAE）确实出现 NPLVM 整体不敌非 PLVM 基线（GSTAE、DGDL、iTransformer）的现象，作者据此认为瓶颈在"变分分布的参数化方式"，主张"放松目标函数"而非"换更花哨的变分族"。同时指出现有 Wasserstein-近端框架偏于问题无关的通用测度值动力学，缺少面向 KL 型隐变量推断的可实现方案与模型专属收敛保证。
AI.method: 整体分三层：(1) 目标松弛——在 Wasserstein 空间 P2 上求解 argmin_{Q_T} D_KL[Q_T||P(z|D)] + (1/(2ε))·W2²(Q_T, Q)，利用连续性方程 Q_T = Q − ε∇·(Qv) + O(ε²) 展开，并结合 KL 对 Q 的第一变分 ∇δD_KL/δQ = ∇log Q − ∇log P，推得最优输运映射 T(z)=z+ε[∇log P(z|D) − ∇log Q(z)]，据此给出粒子迭代式 z_{t+1}=z_t+ε[∇log P(z_t|D) − ∇log Q_t(z_t)]。(2) 可实现化——用"检验函数" h(z) 最小化 Q_t 加权平方误差来替代不可解的 ∇log Q_t；由分部积分与高斯散度定理（假设 h 紧支撑、Q 有界）将目标化为 ½‖h‖²_H + E_Q[∇·h]，在 D_LV 维 RKHS 上参数化 h，谱分解得闭式最优解 h_RKHS(z) = −E_{Q_t(z')}[∇_{z'}K(z',z)]，取 RBF 核实现（式29），形成 Algorithm 1（KProx）。Theorem 2 证明在 ‖v‖≤A、‖∇v‖≤B 下取 ε=1/√T 时 KL 散度单调下降且 lim_T D[Q_T||P(z|D)]=0，即渐近摆脱近似误差；补充材料给出偏差-方差分析（ε 大→近端效应强但离散化偏差大，粒子数 ℓ 增→方差降）。(3) 网络参数学习——生成网络 θ 以粒子经验分布做 MLE（θ←θ−ε(1/ℓ)Σ∇log p_θ(D|z_{i,T})）；推断网络 φ 以 W2²(q_φ(z|x), Q_T(z)) 为损失，用熵正则化 OT 的 Sinkhorn-Knopp 迭代求最优耦合 π*，并借助包络定理得 ∂W2²/∂ẑ_j = ∂L/∂ẑ_j = −2Σ_i π_ij(z_{i,T}−ẑ_j)，实现反传更新 φ（Algorithm 2、3）。测试阶段编码器与解码器串联即可预测，先验取 N(0,I)。
AI.result: RQ1：KProx 能把 Q_t 从初始 N(0,1) 或 U(−0.5,0.5) 平滑演化为双峰目标后验，W2(Q_t, P(z|D)) 随 t 单调下降，且对初始分布不敏感（图3）；玩具例显示高斯族内的变分分布无法拟合多峰后验，而 KProx 可逐步逼近。RQ2：三个工业数据集（DBC 脱丁烷塔底丁烷浓度、CAC 出口 CO2 浓度、CSC 一氧化碳浓度）上，KProxNPLVM 全面最优——DBC R²=0.998、RMSE=9.84E-3、MAPE=9.25%；CAC R²=0.752、RMSE=3.55E-3；CSC R²=0.941、RMSE=0.144，12 项指标中赢 11 项，且对多数基线通过配对 t 检验（p<0.05）；标准差亦处于前三，训练时间较最强基线 iTransformer 缩短 14.1%(DBC)/40.7%(WGS/CSC 41.71s)，显存 549MB 与基线同量级。RQ3：DBC 上敏感性显示 ε 增大性能提升、批大小过大变差、学习率宜小、粒子数先升后降（最优 ℓ=10）。RQ4：消融显示去掉 KProx（改回常规高斯先验 VAE）或去掉 Wasserstein 推断网络训练都会显著退化（如 DBC R² 从 0.998 降至约 −23.9 与 −4.2），且两模块的收敛曲线均变差。RQ5：期望对数似然在 5 个 epoch 内快速收敛至 0 附近且方差很小，与 Theorem 2 一致。
AI.conclusion: 结论是"放松目标而非扩大参数化"可有效消除 AVI 的近似误差地板：以 Wasserstein 距离作为近端算子 + RKHS 正则化的粒子近端递推，可在不限定变分族形状的前提下渐近逼近真实后验（D_KL→0），从而提升 NPLVM 软测量的精度与稳定性，且推理阶段仅需一次前向传播、训练开销与 SOTA 基线相当，具备在线部署可行性。局限与未来工作：用 RKHS 近似速度场限制了在高维隐变量下的表达力，未来应引入神经网络重新设计速度场近似；也可探索以 KL 散度等其它差异度量作为近端项；工业部署上需根据过程漂移制定周期性或触发式重训练策略（残差持续升高/分布漂移统计量超阈值触发）。

title: Automating Skill Acquisition through Large-Scale Mining of Open-Source Agentic Repositories: A Framework for Multi-Agent Procedural Knowledge Extraction
summary: The transition from monolithic large language models (LLMs) to modular, skill-equipped agents represents a fundamental architectural shift in artificial intelligence deployment. While general-purpose models demonstrate remarkable breadth in declarative knowledge, their utility in autonomous workflows is frequently constrained by insufficient specialized procedural expertise. This report investigates a systematic framework for automated acquisition of high-quality agent skills through mining of open-source repositories on platforms such as GitHub. We focus on the extraction of visualization and educational capabilities from state-of-the-art systems including TheoremExplainAgent and Code2Video, both utilizing the Manim mathematical animation engine. The framework encompasses repository structural analysis, semantic skill identification through dense retrieval, and translation to the standardized SKILL.md format. We demonstrate that systematic extraction from agentic repositories, combined with rigorous security governance and multi-dimensional evaluation metrics, enables scalable acquisition of procedural knowledge that augments LLM capabilities without requiring model retraining. Our analysis reveals that agent-generated educational content can achieve 40\% gains in knowledge transfer efficiency while maintaining pedagogical quality comparable to human-crafted tutorials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套"从开源智能体仓库自动挖掘技能"的通用框架：先用 repo2AI 做仓库结构解析，再以双编码器稠密检索 + 交叉编码器重排序定位"潜在技能"，最后翻译为标准 SKILL.md（YAML frontmatter + 分层指令 + 脚本/引用资源），并配套多维评测指标与 G1–G4 四级安全验证管线。作者以 TheoremExplainAgent(TEA) 与 Code2Video（均基于 Manim）为案例，抽取"可视化定理讲解""视觉布局评审"两个示例技能，主张该路径可让 LLM 在不重训练的前提下获得可组合、可治理的程序性知识（知识迁移效率提升约 40%）。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型虽具备丰富的声明性知识，但在自主工作流中缺乏专用程序性（procedural） expertise。传统技能获取路径存在明显瓶颈：领域专家手工编写技能可靠但扩展性极差；智能体自主发现的方法在开放环境中难以保持语义连贯与教学价值。而 GitHub 上大量开源智能体仓库（尤其是 TheoremExplainAgent、Code2Video 这类多智能体可视化/教育内容生成系统）已经隐含了大量高质量的领域程序逻辑，若能系统性重构为标准化、可复用、可治理的技能单元，即可低成本地把"模型参数内的知识"迁移为"文件系统中的可执行程序性知识"。核心问题是把"如何训练模型完成任务 X"改写为"如何为模型提供任务 X 的可执行程序性知识"，并解决规模化获取这一关键挑战。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义：技能表示为四元组 S=(C, π, T, R)，分别对应适用条件（启动集）、策略（核心程序性知识）、终止条件（可验证的成功判据）、接口（标准化可调用边界），用以区别于原子工具与情节记忆。2) SKILL.md 规范与渐进式披露三层架构：Level 1 元数据（YAML frontmatter，30–100 token，启动预载）、Level 2 指令（工作流/最佳实践，激活时注入为隐藏消息，200–5000 token）、Level 3 资源（脚本/参考/模板，按需加载，无上限）。3) 三阶段抽取流水线：(a) 仓库结构分析与情境化——repo2AI 生成目录与文件 Markdown 映射，识别核心编排脚本（如 generate_video.py）与配置目录（task_generator/prompts_raw）；(b) 语义技能识别——双阶段排序，先用双编码器计算任务-模块余弦相似度取 Top-K，再用交叉编码器精排并以阈值 τ 过滤，筛选标准为复现性、可验证性、非显然性、可泛化性；(c) 翻译为 SKILL.md——生成 name/description/version/trigger/dependencies frontmatter，撰写面向 LLM 消费的分步指令（含决策点、错误处理、失败模式），并重构打包 scripts/、references/、templates/ 资源以消除硬编码路径与密钥。4) 案例分析：TEA 的 Planner-Coder 双智能体 + Manim 错误修正循环 + RAG 文档接地；Code2Video 的 Planner-Coder-Critic 三智能体、Visual Anchor Prompting（10×10 网格坐标化 + 阈值 τ_overlap 的遮挡检测）与 TeachQuiz 评测。5) 多维评测（安全/完备性/可执行性/可维护性/教学性）与 G1 静态分析、G2 语义分类、G3 沙箱行为、G4 权限清单四级信任分级验证。
AI.result: 框架产出两个可复用技能：visual-theorem-walkthrough（Manim 动画化定理讲解，含场景规划、语音同步、API 纠错循环、连贯性校验）与 visual-layout-critic（网格化视觉布局审查与重排建议模板）。引用的经验证据包括：Code2Video 完整 Planner-Coder-Critic 架构使知识迁移效率提升约 40%，部分类别超过人工教程；TEA 中 o3-mini 在 TheoremExplainBench 上得分 0.77；SkillNet 本体化整合使执行步数减少 30%、跨骨干模型平均任务奖励提升 40%；社区技能调研发现 26.1% 存在注入或权限提升等漏洞（支撑四级安全管线设计）；渐进式披露支持 10,000+ 技能的意识管理，且相比微调可将能力更新成本降低 2–3 个数量级。需注意：论文性质偏框架/报告性综述，40% 与 0.77 等核心数字主要引自 Code2Video 与 TEA 原文，而非本文自采的端到端抽取实验，本文自身缺少对抽取准确率、召回率与技能质量的直接定量验证。
AI.conclusion: 系统的结构化抽取（仓库分析 → 稠密检索语义识别 → SKILL.md 标准化翻译）可把 GitHub 开源智能体仓库中的隐含程序性知识规模化转化为高质量智能体技能，在无需模型重训练的前提下增强 LLM 的领域能力，并使其在教学与可视化等场景下达到或超过人工编写内容的质量与可扩展性。技术关键在于：可执行代码是编码视觉与教学专长的最优载体；技能（程序性知识）与 MCP（系统连通性）构成正交的智能体栈两层；安全治理需以软件包管理级别的严格度对待技能安装；技能库应通过本体论组织从扁平集合升级为支持组合推理的知识图谱。展望 Evolution Agent 从对话日志与执行轨迹中持续精炼技能，实现从单体静态智能向模块化、持续演化技能生态的架构转型。

title: Deep Learning Network-Temporal Models For Traffic Prediction
summary: Time series analysis is critical for emerging net- work intelligent control and management functions. However, existing statistical-based and shallow machine learning models have shown limited prediction capabilities on multivariate time series. The intricate topological interdependency and complex temporal patterns in network data demand new model approaches. In this paper, based on a systematic multivariate time series model study, we present two deep learning models aiming for learning both temporal patterns and network topological correlations at the same time: a customized network-temporal graph attention network (GAT) model and a fine-tuned multi-modal large language model (LLM) with a clustering overture. Both models are studied against an LSTM model that already outperforms the statistical methods. Through extensive training and performance studies on a real-world network dataset, the LLM-based model demonstrates superior overall prediction and generalization performance, while the GAT model shows its strength in reducing prediction variance across the time series and horizons. More detailed analysis also reveals important insights into correlation variability and prediction distribution discrepancies over time series and different prediction horizons.

AI.tldr: 面向大规模骨干网流量的多变量时间序列预测，提出拓扑感知的学习框架：以 LSTM 为基线，设计网络-时间图注意力网络 NT-GAT，并提出在多模态 LLM（CALF，基于 GPT-2）之上加入 Spearman 互相关聚类前置处理的 Cluster-CALF。在真实骨干网数据上，Cluster-CALF 相对 LSTM 的最佳平均 sMAPE 降低 41.31%，聚类阶段再降低 2.18%（标准差降 3.41%）；NT-GAT 平均精度略逊于 LSTM，但显著收敛了各时间序列间的预测方差。
AI.motivation: 现有统计模型（ARIMA/SARIMAX 等）与浅层深度模型在多变量时序上预测能力有限：统计模型需预定义全局参数、难泛化于非平稳含多重季节性的网络流量，且逐序列训练开销大；多数工作只优化平均误差，忽视了个别时间序列之间的性能方差、异构依赖结构以及随时间演化的相关性。同时，网络流量数据天然带有链路拓扑互依赖，但很少有深度学习工作显式建模该拓扑结构；LLM/基础模型在时序预测上兴起，但"LLM + 显式结构依赖建模"的结合在网络流量场景仍属空白。此外，时序基准数据集数值量级小、序列数少，无法代表大规模网络数据的规模与拓扑特征，且常忽略指标选择、交叉验证、数据缩放、预测视野与信息泄漏等评测陷阱。
AI.method: 问题建模：将骨干网络抽象为线图 L(g)=(N,V)，NTS 为 R^{T×N×C}，由依赖图 G(N,E) 描述序列间依赖；采用直接式（direct）多步长预测并划分训练/验证/测试。基线：单层 LSTM + Dropout + Dense，多变量输入、变长输出窗口，经网格/随机搜索确定序列长度、隐藏单元、dropout、学习率、批大小、损失等超参；损失用 Huber（抗噪抗离群），优化器 Adam，StandardScaler 仅在训练集上拟合以避免信息泄漏；并先用含频域统计外生变量的 SARIMAX 单变量模型做分解与短期/长期表现考察（结果未优于 LSTM）。NT-GAT：以多头（通常 8 头）图注意力层按自定义邻接矩阵与跳数（hop=2–5 最优）聚合邻居与远距离节点信息，后接两层 LSTM（hidden 64、128）与线性层输出多视野预测。LLM 支线：沿用 CALF（Cross-ModAl LLM Fine-Tuning）框架，基于 GPT-2，通过对原生词嵌入做 PCA 抽取主成分词向量、交叉注意力生成对齐文本 token、特征正则化损失对齐隐层状态、输出一致性损失弥合模态差距，并对时序分支用 LoRA 做参数高效微调，天然支持序列到序列预测。核心贡献 Cluster-CALF：先以无监督聚类作为"前奏层"，用 Spearman 秩相关（对非正态、离群、非线性更稳健，优于 Pearson）构建亲和度矩阵，将约百条双向链路流量序列划分为 6/7/8 个簇（7 簇最优），各簇分别送入 CALF 训练，以降低输入维度、缓解多重共线性、稳定学习。评测：主指标为尺度无关的 sMAPE（同时报告 MAE），除平均误差外还统计各序列上的误差分布（均值与中位数差距、标准差），并在多个预测视野与不同序列长度下对比。实验使用 SLURM + GPU 环境跑超参扫描与最终训练，日志全量记录。
AI.result: LSTM 最优配置为视野 1 小时、序列长度 336，最佳平均 sMAPE 约 56.26%，长视野明显退化且序列长度影响不显著，序列间性能分布弥散（中位数与均值差距大，存在离群序列）；所有传统统计模型均未超越 LSTM。NT-GAT 在不同视野间性能差异更小、误差分布更集中于低值区（注意力机制的正向体现），但平均表现劣于更简单的 LSTM，提示过拟合；连通性越高的节点误差分布越低，Huber 损失优于其他损失，2–5 跳为最佳权衡。CALF 同样在视野 1 最优，最佳平均 sMAPE 相对 LSTM 降低 41.31%，且 sMAPE 分布标准差降低 29%，即同时提升平均精度与稳定性。聚类前置后，6/7/8 簇均优于无聚类基线；7 簇配置下平均 sMAPE 再降 2.18%、分布标准差再降 3.41%，并在所有测试视野上一致优于单模型基线，中等视野增益最大（视野 6 时平均 sMAPE 降 4.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 结论：多模态 LLM 路线（CALF / Cluster-CALF）在真实骨干网流量预测上同时取得最佳平均精度、最佳泛化性与最紧的序列间误差分布，显著优于 LSTM 基线与统计模型；NT-GAT 虽平均精度不足，但在降低跨时间序列与跨预测视野的预测方差方面展现独特价值，表明拓扑感知建模与注意力聚合对异构网络条件下的可靠性有意义。方法论层面的启示是：拓扑感知建模、依赖感知预处理（聚类以削减冗余共线序列）与分布敏感型评测（而非只看平均误差）三者是可扩展可靠网络预测的关键。作者亦坦承局限：未做效率分析，未与既有 LLM/Transformer 模型直接对比（以 CALF 已超越它们为据），聚类前置带来多次小任务训练的计算权衡未量化。未来工作：更系统的效率与计算权衡分析（簇数与组成联合优化精度与效率）、引入 DTW 等时序感知聚类与无监督学习模型、以及利用数据本身的图表示进一步与图模型融合。

title: VisiFold: Long-Term Traffic Forecasting via Temporal Folding Graph and Node Visibility
summary: Traffic forecasting is a cornerstone of intelligent transportation systems. While existing research has made significant progress in short-term prediction, long-term forecasting remains a largely uncharted and challenging frontier. Extending the prediction horizon intensifies two critical issues: escalating computational resource consumption and increasingly complex spatial-temporal dependencies. Current approaches, which rely on spatial-temporal graphs and process temporal and spatial dimensions separately, suffer from snapshot-stacking inflation and cross-step fragmentation. To overcome these limitations, we propose \textit{VisiFold}. Our framework introduces a novel temporal folding graph that consolidates a sequence of temporal snapshots into a single graph. Furthermore, we present a node visibility mechanism that incorporates node-level masking and subgraph sampling to overcome the computational bottleneck imposed by large node counts. Extensive experiments show that VisiFold not only drastically reduces resource consumption but also outperforms existing baselines in long-term forecasting tasks. Remarkably, even with a high mask ratio of 80\%, VisiFold maintains its performance advantage. By effectively breaking the resource constraints in both temporal and spatial dimensions, our work paves the way for more realistic long-term traffic forecasting. The code is available at~ https://github.com/PlanckChang/VisiFold.

AI.tldr: VisiFold 面向长时交通预测，把"多快照的时空图"重新设计为"时间折叠图（TFG）+ 节点可见性（node-level masking + subgraph sampling）"，在 PEMS04/PEMS08/SEATTLE 三个数据集、24/36/48 步预测 horizon 上同时取得 SOTA 精度与显著资源节省（相对 STAEformer 训练提速 17.8×、推理提速 18.5×、显存减少 15.7×；掩码率高达 80% 仍保持性能优势，推理耗时 <1 秒）。
AI.motivation: 长时交通预测（预测 horizon 远大于 1 小时）存在两个核心瓶颈：计算资源消耗剧增与时空依赖复杂化。现有基于时空图的方法把每个时间片视为一个 snapshot，用空间模块在快照内聚合、时间模块跨步传播，导致两个结构性问题：(1) snapshot-stacking inflation——显存与运行时间随步长 T 和节点数 N 快速膨胀；(2) cross-step fragmentation——时序依赖被割裂在多个中间表示之间跨步传递，损害长期依赖建模。作者指出此前长时预测工作（如 SSTBAN）只关注精度或仅以瓶颈注意力降本，未触及输入表示这一根因。
AI.method:
核心是重新设计骨干网络的输入 tokenization/表示，而非改进架构：
1) 时间折叠图 (Temporal Folding Graph, TFG)：把一个节点在 T 个快照上的全部属性压缩为单个 TF-token（X_TF^n = Squeeze(X)[n] ∈ R^{1×T}），token 数从 N×T 降为 N；时序动态被压缩进节点内部，空间与时间依赖在单张图上同步交互，消除跨步消息传递与 snapshot 堆叠。复杂度由 O(N·g(T)+T·h(N)) 降为 O(h(N))。
2) 嵌入融合：线性投影得到 E_x ∈ R^{N×d}，与可学习空间嵌入 E_s、时间-of-day 嵌入 E_tod（频率维度查表、末时刻取值、全节点共享）、day-of-week 嵌入 E_dow 拼接为 E ∈ R^{N×4d}。
3) 节点可见性 (Node Visibility，仅训练时启用，推理时用全量 E)：节点级掩码随机移除 r·N 个节点使其对编码器不可见（借鉴 MAE；优于置零/随机值等策略，避免训练-测试不一致）；子图采样将剩余节点随机划分为大小为 s 的子图并零填充 p 个节点，得 Z_0 ∈ R^{((1-r)N+p)/s × s × 4d}，以并行化并降低注意力二次代价，最终复杂度 O((1-r)Ns + ps)。
4) 网络：L 层 Transformer 编码器（MSA + FFN，前置 LayerNorm、残差连接）+ GELU MLP 预测头，Huber Loss(δ=1)，Adam lr=1e-4，batch 16，单卡 3090。超参：mask ratio 0.2，子图大小 PEMS04/SEATTLE=50、PEMS08=30，embedding dim 64/32/64。
AI.result: 精度：三个数据集 × 24/36/48 步共 9 个场景全部取得最优 RMSE/MAE/MAPE（如 PEMS04-24: 31.36/19.07/12.44；PEMS08-24: 25.31/14.73/9.84；SEATTLE-24: 7.22/3.82/11.87），STID/STAEformer/SSTBAN 居次；STPGNN 在长时场景明显退化。效率：相对 STAEformer 训练提速 17.8×、推理 18.5×、显存降至 1/15.7；相对 STID 显存 5.1×、训练 7.8×、推理 1.3×；显存随步长增长极小，推理 <1 秒。消融：空间嵌入贡献最大（去除后 RMSE +8.22），时间嵌入次之（E_tod +0.35、E_dow +0.19）；完整节点可见性使误差中位数下降且波动区间收窄（PEMS04 内存 −12.22%）；掩码率 0.2 最优，0.9 时性能骤降但仍优于基线，且每轮时间与显存随掩码率单调下降；子图过大使 padding 增多、资源波动，需权衡。对照实验：沿空间维折叠（SF）显著劣于 TFG（因无法加空间嵌入）；节点级时间嵌入与 leader-token 跨子图交互（共享/独立）均无增益，说明限制可见性反而避免捷径、抑制过拟合；可视化（t-SNE）显示 E_tod 呈单峰对称结构、E_s 中空间不相邻但模式相似的节点（72/95/111）聚在一起，支持"放弃拓扑先验"的论点。误差分析显示模型能捕捉主趋势，但在 9:00–15:00 高峰时段剧烈波动处误差上升。
AI.conclusion: VisiFold 通过同时打破时间维（TFG 折叠快照）与空间维（节点可见性）的资源约束，为长时交通预测提供了既更准又更省的统一框架，代码已开源。其贡献在于把"输入表示/分词"而非"模型结构"作为提升长时预测效率与泛化的切入点，并给出"限制节点可见性可抑制捷径学习、摆脱拓扑先验依赖"的新视角。局限：纯数据驱动、无法应对突发/异常事件（事故、道路封闭、大型活动）；尚未整合多模态元数据；TFG 将时序建模完全交给嵌入层，缺少显式时序模块；方法向更广泛时空任务的迁移仍待验证。未来方向包括引入时序模块、融合多模态信息、拓展至更大规模路网与边缘实时部署。

title: Leveraging Phytolith Research using Artificial Intelligence
summary: Phytolith analysis is a crucial tool for reconstructing past vegetation and human activities, but traditional methods are severely limited by labour-intensive, time-consuming manual microscopy. To address this bottleneck, we present Sorometry: a comprehensive end-to-end artificial intelligence pipeline for the high-throughput digitisation, inference, and interpretation of phytoliths. Our workflow processes z-stacked optical microscope scans to automatically generate synchronised 2D orthoimages and 3D point clouds of individual microscopic particles. We developed a multimodal fusion model that combines ConvNeXt for 2D image analysis and PointNet++ for 3D point cloud analysis, supported by a graphical user interface for expert annotation and review. Tested on reference collections and archaeological samples from the Bolivian Amazon, our fusion model achieved a global classification accuracy of 77.9\% across 24 diagnostic morphotypes and 84.5% for segmentation quality. Crucially, the integration of 3D data proved essential for distinguishing complex morphotypes (such as grass silica short cell phytoliths) whose diagnostic features are often obscured by their orientation in 2D projections. Beyond individual object classification, Sorometry incorporates Bayesian finite mixture modelling to predict overall plant source contributions at the assemblage level, successfully identifying specific plants like maize and palms in complex mixed samples. This integrated platform transforms phytolith research into an "omics"-scale discipline, dramatically expanding analytical capacity, standardising expert judgements, and enabling reproducible, population-level characterisations of archaeological and paleoecological assemblages.

AI.tldr: Sorometry是一个端到端的人工智能pipeline,用于高通量数字化、推理和解释植物硅酸体(phytoliths),结合2D图像分析(ConvNeXt)和3D点云分析(PointNet++),在24种诊断形态类型上达到77.9%的分类准确率,并通过贝叶斯混合模型在组合层面预测植物来源。
AI.motivation: 传统植物硅酸体分析方法依赖人工显微镜观察,劳动密集且耗时,严重限制了分析能力,需要一个高通量、自动化的解决方案来突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 开发了多模态融合模型,结合ConvNeXt(2D图像分析)和PointNet++(3D点云分析),处理堆叠光学显微镜扫描生成同步的2D正交图像和3D点云;使用贝叶斯有限混合模型在组合层面预测植物来源贡献;提供图形用户界面供专家注释和审查。
AI.result: 在全球24种诊断形态类型分类中达到77.9%的准确率,分割质量达84.5%。3D数据集成对于区分复杂形态类型(如草本硅酸短细胞)至关重要,因为其诊断特征在2D投影中常因方向问题而被遮挡。成功识别出混合样本中的玉米和棕榈等特定植物。
AI.conclusion: Sorometry将植物硅酸体研究转变为"组学"规模的学科,显著扩展了分析能力,标准化了专家判断,并实现了考古和古生态组合的可重复、群体水平特征描述。

title: Automated Detection of Malignant Lesions in the Ovary Using Deep Learning Models and XAI
comment: Accepted and published at ICAIC 2025. Accepted version
summary: The unrestrained proliferation of cells that are malignant in nature is cancer. In recent times, medical professionals are constantly acquiring enhanced diagnostic and treatment abilities by implementing deep learning models to analyze medical data for better clinical decision, disease diagnosis and drug discovery. A majority of cancers are studied and treated by incorporating these technologies. However, ovarian cancer remains a dilemma as it has inaccurate non-invasive detection procedures and a time consuming, invasive procedure for accurate detection. Thus, in this research, several Convolutional Neural Networks such as LeNet-5, ResNet, VGGNet and GoogLeNet/Inception have been utilized to develop 15 variants and choose a model that accurately detects and identifies ovarian cancer. For effective model training, the dataset OvarianCancer&SubtypesDatasetHistopathology from Mendeley has been used. After constructing a model, we utilized Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) models such as LIME, Integrated Gradients and SHAP to explain the black box outcome of the selected model. For evaluating the performance of the model, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, ROC Curve and AUC have been used. From the evaluation, it was seen that the slightly compact InceptionV3 model with ReLu had the overall best result achieving an average score of 94% across all the performance metrics in the augmented dataset. Lastly for XAI, the three aforementioned XAI have been used for an overall comparative analysis. It is the aim of this research that the contributions of the study will help in achieving a better detection method for ovarian cancer.

AI.tldr: 本文针对卵巢癌病理组织学图像，构建并比较了15个CNN变体（LeNet、ResNet、VGG16/19、InceptionV1/V3，含ReLu/tanh、dropout、学习率、批归一化等改动），在Mendeley的OvarianCancer&SubtypesDatasetHistopathology（5类、498张原图，经旋转/翻转/亮度对比度等复合增强至2490张）上训练，最终选定**从头构建的InceptionV3-A（ReLu）**为基模型（约94.58%准确率、94.75%精确率、94.62% F1），并用LIME、Integrated Gradients、SHAP三种XAI方法解释其黑箱预测；作者明确说明放弃了分数更高的VGG16-A/VGG19（96.99%/97.19%），原因是迁移学习模型难以施加XAI解释。
AI.motivation: 卵巢癌缺乏有效的无创筛查手段（无乳腺X线、Pap筛查类手段），目前确诊依赖经阴道超声、盆腔检查、CA-125及 invasive 活检，且往往确诊于晚期，是全球女性第七常见癌症、死亡率最高的妇科肿瘤。深度学习在多数癌症的计算机辅助检测（CAD）中已取得进展，但卵巢癌方向的模型精度与可解释性仍不足，且模型的黑箱输出难以被临床医生信任。因此作者希望：①在组织病理学图像上筛选高精度CNN用于恶性/亚型识别；②引入XAI（LIME、Integrated Gradients、SHAP）解决临床可解释性问题；③探索更高效的数据增强与预处理流程以缓解小样本数据问题。
AI.method: 1) 数据：Mendeley公开数据集OvarianCancer&SubtypesDatasetHistopathology，5类（Clear Cell、Endometri、Mucinous、Non-Cancerous、Serous），每类98–100张，共498张，类别基本平衡。2) 预处理/增强：使用Albumentations库做复合增强（旋转至多180°、水平/垂直翻转、亮度、对比度、饱和度、色相调整），每原图生成4张增强图，原始+增强共2490张，JPG/RGB格式。3) 张量化与归一化：TensorFlow的image_dataset_from_directory，labels="inferred"、label_mode="int"（避免one-hot以便后续扩展子类）、color_mode=RGB、batch_size=32；图像尺寸按模型需求在32×32与224×224间切换；按seed/subset/shuffle随机做80:20划分（训练1992张、测试498张）；uint8→float32后归一化至[0,1]；用tf.concat拼接X、Y。4) 模型：构建15个变体——LeNet-A/B/C（学习率0.001、加dropout、加步长衰减，100 epochs）；ResNet-34_32、ResNet-34_224、ResNet-50、ResNet-101（学习率1e-4~0.1、dropout 0~0.9区间随机采样10组、每组3 epochs，选测试准确率最佳组合）；VGG16-A/B/C、VGG19（迁移学习，仅定制全连接层，含GAP、1024/1024/512稠密层，tanh与ReLu、学习率0.03%+dropout 20%等变体）；InceptionV1-A/B、InceptionV3-A/B（仅用2个inception模块、去掉辅助分类器、InceptionV3引入批归一化与3×3首层、调整各模块滤波器数）。输出层统一Softmax（给出公式）。5) 评估：Accuracy、Precision、Recall、F1、ROC曲线与AUC。6) XAI：LIME与Integrated Gradients（局部post-hoc）及SHAP（局部化全局post-hoc），对所选模型的预测做可视化解释，并对三者做对比分析。
AI.result: 15个变体结果：LeNet-A 61.85%（最佳）、LeNet-B 55.02%、LeNet-C 53.21%；ResNet-34_32 43.78%、ResNet-34_224 57.03%、ResNet-50 34.14%、ResNet-101 43.17%（ResNet系列整体最差）；VGG16-A 96.99%、VGG16-B 96.18%、VGG16-C 96.18%、VGG19 97.19%（最优，但为迁移学习）；InceptionV1-A 78.92%、InceptionV1-B 85.74%、InceptionV3-A 94.58%、InceptionV3-B 82.13%。最终选定InceptionV3-A作为基模型，各项指标平均约94–94.75%（Accuracy 94.58%、Precision 94.75%、Recall 94.58%、F1 94.62%），ROC/AUC在15个模型中亦属较优。与Kasture等的VGG16-O对比：原始数据集上VGG16-O为50%、InceptionV3-A为20.20%（因未预训练），增强数据集上VGG16-O为84.64%（20 epochs/24742图），VGG16-A为96.99%、InceptionV3-A为94.58%（80 epochs/2490图）。XAI结果：SHAP图中正确预测样本的正向贡献特征集中于其真实类别；LIME、SHAP、Integrated Gradients三者高亮区域高度一致，共同揭示预测依据，LIME因限制仅展示10个重要特征而显得更稀疏，说明黑箱解释成功。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了在小型卵巢癌组织病理学数据集上，配合精心设计的增强与归一化预处理，从头训练的InceptionV3-ReLu模型可在约94.5–94.75%的准确率/精确率/召回率/F1上实现恶性病变与亚型的自动识别，精度接近基于迁移学习的VGG模型（差距约2.4个百分点）；同时LIME、Integrated Gradients与SHAP三种XAI方法给出高度一致的解释，证明XAI可在迁移学习模型上难以应用的情况下对从头构建模型提供可靠的临床可解释性。作者将其定位为"初步成功"的sandbox原型，后续工作将精简系统并转向使用无创数据（如血液标志物、影像）以实现早期预测与更快速检测。需注意的局限：数据规模小（仅498张原图）、未做外部/跨中心验证与统计显著性检验，ResNet表现异常偏低，XAI解释仅做定性可视化比较而无忠实性度量，模型偏向"形态学上可分"的组织学亚型而非真正的早期风险预测。

title: CreativeBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Machine Creativity via Self-Evolving Challenges
summary: The saturation of high-quality pre-training data has shifted research focus toward evolutionary systems capable of continuously generating novel artifacts, leading to the success of AlphaEvolve. However, the progress of such systems is hindered by the lack of rigorous, quantitative evaluation. To tackle this challenge, we introduce CreativeBench, a benchmark for evaluating machine creativity in code generation, grounded in a classical cognitive framework. Comprising two subsets -- CreativeBench-Combo and CreativeBench-Explore -- the benchmark targets combinatorial and exploratory creativity through an automated pipeline utilizing reverse engineering and self-play. By leveraging executable code, CreativeBench objectively distinguishes creativity from hallucination via a unified metric defined as the product of quality and novelty. Our analysis of state-of-the-art models reveals distinct behaviors: (1) scaling significantly improves combinatorial creativity but yields diminishing returns for exploration; (2) larger models exhibit ``convergence-by-scaling,'' becoming more correct but less divergent; and (3) reasoning capabilities primarily benefit constrained exploration rather than combination. Finally, we propose EvoRePE, a plug-and-play inference-time steering strategy that internalizes evolutionary search patterns to consistently enhance machine creativity.

AI.tldr: 针对机器创造力评估难题，提出 CreativeBench 基准测试（含组合与探索两个子集），通过可执行代码和统一度量（质量×新颖性）客观区分创造力与幻觉；实验揭示模型规模与推理能力的差异化影响，并提出 EvoRePE 策略持续提升机器创造力。
AI.motivation: 高质量预训练数据趋于饱和，研究转向能够持续生成新事物的进化系统（如AlphaEvolve），但缺乏严格、定量的评估方法来衡量这些系统的创造力。
AI.method: 提出 CreativeBench 基准，包含两个子集（CreativeBench-Combo 和 CreativeBench-Explore），采用自动化管道利用逆向工程和自我博弈；通过可执行代码客观区分创造力与幻觉，采用质量与新颖性乘积的统一度量；提出 EvoRePE 即插即用推理时引导策略。
AI.result: 缩放模型显著提升组合创造力，但对探索能力提升有限；大模型呈现"缩放趋同"现象——更正确但更少分歧；推理能力主要有益于受约束的探索而非组合任务。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明 EvoRePE 作为即插即用的推理时引导策略，能够通过内化进化搜索模式持续提升机器创造力；研究揭示了模型规模与创造力之间的复杂关系，为未来创造性AI系统的设计提供了重要参考。

title: Attention Sinks Are Provably Necessary in Softmax Transformers: Evidence from Trigger-Conditional Tasks
summary: Transformers often display an attention sink: probability mass concentrates on a fixed, content-agnostic position. We prove that computing a simple trigger-conditional behavior necessarily induces a sink in softmax self-attention models. Our results formalize a familiar intuition: normalization over a probability simplex must force attention to collapse onto a stable anchor to realize a default state (e.g., when the model needs to ignore the input). We instantiate this with a concrete task: when a designated trigger token appears, the model must return the average of all preceding token representations, and otherwise output zero, a task which mirrors the functionality of attention heads in the wild (Barbero et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2024). We also prove that non-normalized ReLU attention can solve the same task without any sink, confirming that the normalization constraint is the fundamental driver of sink behavior. Experiments validate our predictions and demonstrate they extend beyond the theoretically analyzed setting: softmax models develop strong sinks while ReLU attention eliminates them in both single-head and multi-head variants.

AI.tldr: 本文证明计算trigger-conditional行为必然在softmax自注意力中诱导attention sink，因为归一化约束强制模型将注意力collapse到固定锚点以实现默认状态（如忽略输入）。非归一化的ReLU注意力可避免sink，实验验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: Transformers中的attention sink现象（概率质量集中在固定的位置）已被广泛观察，但尚不清楚其产生的根本原因。作者试图回答：计算特定trigger条件行为是否必然导致softmax注意力产生sink。
AI.method: 理论证明+实验验证：(1) 形式化证明trigger-conditional任务必然在softmax自注意力中诱导sink；(2) 证明非归一化ReLU注意力可在无sink情况下解决同一任务；(3) 在单头和多头变体中验证预测。
AI.result: 理论预测：softmax注意力为实现"忽略输入"的默认状态必须在概率 simplex上归一化，从而强制注意力collapse到一个稳定的锚点；非归一化的ReLU注意力可在无sink情况下解决相同任务。实验验证：softmax模型产生强sink，ReLU注意力消除了sink。任务设定：trigger token出现时返回所有前序token表示的平均值，否则输出零。
AI.conclusion: 归一化约束是softmax注意力产生sink的根本原因；非归一化的ReLU注意力可以在不产生sink的情况下完成相同任务；实验验证了该理论预测在单头和多头场景下均成立。

title: KEPo: Knowledge Evolution Poison on Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Accepted in the ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW 2026)
summary: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) constructs the Knowledge Graph (KG) from external databases to enhance the timeliness and accuracy of Large Language Model (LLM) generations.However,this reliance on external data introduces new attack surfaces.Attackers can inject poisoned texts into databases to manipulate LLMs into producing harmful target responses for attacker-chosen queries.Existing research primarily focuses on attacking conventional RAG systems.However,such methods are ineffective against GraphRAG.This robustness derives from the KG abstraction of GraphRAG,which reorganizes injected text into a graph before retrieval,thereby enabling the LLM to reason based on the restructured context instead of raw poisoned passages.To expose latent security vulnerabilities in GraphRAG,we propose Knowledge Evolution Poison (KEPo),a novel poisoning attack method specifically designed for GraphRAG.For each target query,KEPo first generates a toxic event containing poisoned knowledge based on the target answer.By fabricating event backgrounds and forging knowledge evolution paths from original facts to the toxic event,it then poisons the KG and misleads the LLM into treating the poisoned knowledge as the final result.In multi-target attack scenarios,KEPo further connects multiple attack corpora,enabling their poisoned knowledge to mutually reinforce while expanding the scale of poisoned communities,thereby amplifying attack effectiveness.Experimental results across multiple datasets demonstrate that KEPo achieves state-of-the-art attack success rates for both single-target and multi-target attacks,significantly outperforming previous methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KEPo（知识演化毒化）攻击方法，专门针对GraphRAG系统。攻击者通过生成有毒事件、伪造事件背景和知识演化路径来毒化知识图谱，从而操纵LLM生成有害的目标响应。实验表明该方法在单目标和多目标攻击中均取得最高攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要针对传统RAG系统进行攻击，但这些方法对GraphRAG无效。这是因为GraphRAG通过知识图谱对注入文本进行抽象和重组，使LLM能够基于重组后的上下文进行推理。为揭示GraphRAG的潜在安全漏洞，需要设计专门针对GraphRAG的攻击方法。
AI.method: KEPo攻击方法包括：(1)基于目标答案生成包含毒化知识的有毒事件；(2)伪造事件背景和从原始事实到有毒事件的知识演化路径，从而毒化知识图谱并误导LLM将毒化知识视为最终结果；(3)在多目标攻击场景中连接多个攻击语料库，使毒化知识相互强化并扩大毒化社区规模。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，KEPo在单目标和多目标攻击场景下均达到了最先进的攻击成功率，显著优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: KEPo通过知识演化机制成功突破了GraphRAG基于知识图谱的防御体系，为GraphRAG系统的安全性研究提供了重要参考，同时提醒开发者需要针对此类新型攻击设计相应的防御机制。

title: AdaFuse: Accelerating Dynamic Adapter Inference via Token-Level Pre-Gating and Fused Kernel Optimization
comment: Accepted to AAAI 2026. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2405.17741
summary: The integration of dynamic, sparse structures like Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with parameter-efficient adapters (e.g., LoRA) is a powerful technique for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs). However, this architectural enhancement comes at a steep cost: despite minimal increases in computational load, the inference latency often skyrockets, leading to decoding speeds slowing by over 2.5 times. Through a fine-grained performance analysis, we pinpoint the primary bottleneck not in the computation itself, but in the severe overhead from fragmented, sequential CUDA kernel launches required for conventional dynamic routing. To address this challenge, we introduce AdaFuse, a framework built on a tight co-design between the algorithm and the underlying hardware system to enable efficient dynamic adapter execution. Departing from conventional layer-wise or block-wise routing, AdaFuse employs a token-level pre-gating strategy, which makes a single, global routing decision for all adapter layers before a token is processed. This "decide-once, apply-everywhere" approach effectively staticizes the execution path for each token, creating an opportunity for holistic optimization. We capitalize on this by developing a custom CUDA kernel that performs a fused switching operation, merging the parameters of all selected LoRA adapters into the backbone model in a single, efficient pass. Experimental results on popular open-source LLMs show that AdaFuse achieves accuracy on par with state-of-the-art dynamic adapters while drastically cutting decoding latency by a factor of over 2.4x, thereby bridging the gap between model capability and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: AdaFuse通过令牌级预门控策略和自定义融合CUDA内核，将动态adapter与MoE集成到LLM中的推理延迟降低2.4倍以上，同时保持与先进动态adapter相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 将动态稀疏结构(MoE)与参数高效adapter(LoRA)集成到LLM中虽能增强模型能力，但推理延迟急剧增加（超过2.5倍），其主要瓶颈并非计算本身，而是传统动态路由导致的碎片化顺序CUDA内核启动开销。
AI.method: 提出AdaFuse框架，采用令牌级预门控策略，在处理令牌前对所有adapter层做一次全局路由决策（"一次决策，处处应用"），并开发自定义CUDA内核执行融合切换操作，在单次传递中合并所选LoRA adapter参数到主干模型。
AI.result: 在流行的开源LLM上实验表明，AdaFuse达到与先进动态adapter相当的精度，同时将解码延迟降低超过2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: AdaFuse通过算法与硬件的协同设计，有效弥合了模型能力与推理效率之间的差距，为动态adapter的高效部署提供了可行方案。

title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Generalized Embedding Learning in Federated Recommendation
comment: Accepted by the ACM Web Conference 2026
summary: Federated recommender systems enable collaborative model training while keeping user interaction data local and sharing only essential model parameters, thereby mitigating privacy risks. However, existing methods overlook a critical issue, i.e., the stable learning of a generalized item embedding throughout the federated recommender system training process. Item embedding plays a central role in facilitating knowledge sharing across clients. Yet, under the cross-device setting, local data distributions exhibit significant heterogeneity and sparsity, exacerbating the difficulty of learning generalized embeddings. These factors make the stable learning of generalized item embeddings both indispensable for effective federated recommendation and inherently difficult to achieve. To fill this gap, we propose a new federated recommendation framework, named Federated Recommendation with Generalized Embedding Learning (FedRecGEL). We reformulate the federated recommendation problem from an item-centered perspective and cast it as a multi-task learning problem, aiming to learn generalized embeddings throughout the training procedure. Based on theoretical analysis, we employ sharpness-aware minimization to address the generalization problem, thereby stabilizing the training process and enhancing recommendation performance. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedRecGEL in significantly improving federated recommendation performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/anonymifish/FedRecGEL.

AI.tldr: 针对联邦推荐系统中物品嵌入稳定学习的问题，提出FedRecGEL框架，将联邦推荐问题重新表述为多任务学习问题，并利用锐度感知最小化来稳定训练过程和增强推荐性能，在四个数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法忽略了一个关键问题：在联邦推荐系统训练过程中稳定学习通用物品嵌入。在跨设备设置下，本地数据分布呈现显著的异质性和稀疏性，使得学习通用嵌入变得困难。物品嵌入在促进客户端间的知识共享中起着核心作用。
AI.method: 提出名为Federated Recommendation with Generalized Embedding Learning (FedRecGEL)的新联邦推荐框架。从物品中心视角重新表述联邦推荐问题，并将其转化为多任务学习问题，旨在整个训练过程中学习通用嵌入。基于理论分析，采用锐度感知最小化(sharpness-aware minimization)来解决泛化问题，从而稳定训练过程并提升推荐性能。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上进行了广泛实验，证明了FedRecGEL在显著提升联邦推荐性能方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过物品中心的多任务学习视角和锐度感知最小化技术，有效解决了联邦推荐中物品嵌入的稳定学习问题，提高了模型的泛化能力和推荐性能。

title: Fair Learning for Bias Mitigation and Quality Optimization in Paper Recommendation
comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2602.22438
summary: Despite frequent double-blind review, demographic biases of authors still disadvantage the underrepresented groups. We present Fair-PaperRec, a MultiLayer Perceptron (MLP)-based model that addresses demographic disparities in post-review paper acceptance decisions while maintaining high-quality requirements. Our methodology penalizes demographic disparities while preserving quality through intersectional criteria (e.g., race, country) and a customized fairness loss, in contrast to heuristic approaches. Evaluations using conference data from ACM Special Interest Group on Computer-Human Interaction (SIGCHI), Designing Interactive Systems (DIS), and Intelligent User Interfaces (IUI) indicate a 42.03% increase in underrepresented group participation and a 3.16% improvement in overall utility, indicating that diversity promotion does not compromise academic rigor and supports equity-focused peer review solutions.

AI.tldr: Fair-PaperRec是一个基于MLP的论文推荐模型，通过自定义公平性损失和交叉标准在保持学术质量的同时，将弱势群体参与度提高42.03%，验证了多样性促进与学术严谨性可以兼得。
AI.motivation: 尽管采用双盲评审，作者的人口统计偏见仍然使弱势群体处于不利地位，需要一种方法来解决评审后的论文接受决策中的人口统计差异。
AI.method: 提出Fair-PaperRec模型，这是一个基于多层感知器(MLP)的模型，通过使用交叉标准（如种族、国家）和自定义公平性损失来惩罚人口统计差异，同时保留质量要求，与启发式方法形成对比。
AI.result: 在ACM SIGCHI、DIS和IUI会议数据的评估表明，弱势群体参与度提高了42.03%，整体效用提高了3.16%。
AI.conclusion: 多样性促进不会损害学术严谨性，支持以公平为中心的同行评审解决方案。该研究证明了在学术论文评审中实现公平性与质量兼顾的可行性。

title: LongFlow: Efficient KV Cache Compression for Reasoning M
